import Gopurs.ExprAnalysis (getExprType, isEffectNode)
import Gopurs.ExprContext (ModuleFunctions, StmtTree(..), TranslateExpr, childContext)

translate :: CodegenMetadata -> BackendModule -> String
translate metadata inputMod = (translateWithFunctions metadata inputMod).code

translateWithFunctions :: CodegenMetadata -> BackendModule -> { code :: String, functions :: ModuleFunctions, file :: GoFile }
translateWithFunctions metadata inputMod = translatePreparedWithFunctions metadata (prepareModule metadata inputMod)

type PreparedModule =
  { module :: BackendModule
  , declarations :: Array GoDecl
  , functions :: ModuleFunctions
  , workers :: Map.Map String (Maybe FunctionInfo)
  }

-- These transformations consume source metadata, not imported worker signatures
-- or module-local FFI signatures. Prepare once, before computing the emission
-- key, so references introduced by a transformation belong to its proof too.
prepareModule :: CodegenMetadata -> BackendModule -> PreparedModule
prepareModule metadata inputMod =
  let
    projected = ListFusion.optimize (RegexMatchProjection.optimize metadata inputMod)
    progressions = ListProgressionFold.prepare projected
    constants = ClosedScalar.optimize (RefLoopRegions.optimize progressions.module)
    constructors = ConstructorFold.optimize constants
    schemas = specializeDecoderSchemas metadata (borrowReadOnlyObjects metadata (cacheClosedDictionaries metadata (optimizeImmediateApplications (optimizeFunctionProducers (optimizeThunkProducers constructors)))))
    owned = Ownership.prepare metadata schemas.module
  in
    { module: owned.module
    , declarations: owned.declarations <> schemas.declarations <> progressions.declarations
    , functions: Map.union owned.functions progressions.functions
    , workers: workerInputs metadata.globalFunctions owned.module
    }

-- Imported ordinary and immediate-effect workers use qualified Var targets;
-- local targets use the module's
-- own signatures. Include every such Var, even if it is not called, and record
-- absences in the exact batch snapshot. TCO preserves these qualifications.
workerInputs :: ModuleFunctions -> BackendModule -> Map.Map String (Maybe FunctionInfo)
workerInputs available = foldWorkerReferences
  (\owner name acc -> foldl
    (\entries ident -> let key = unwrap owner <> "." <> ident in Map.insert key (Map.lookup key available) entries)
    acc [ name, ImmediateEffects.key name ])
  Map.empty

-- The emitter can resolve immutable owner contributions without decoding every
-- earlier module's signatures. Keep the exact qualified-Var inventory shared
-- with workerInputs, including FFI targets and references introduced by passes.
workerOwners :: BackendModule -> Set.Set String
workerOwners = foldWorkerReferences (\owner _ -> Set.insert (unwrap owner)) Set.empty

-- Conservative requests are collected explicitly by the emitter. They do not
-- need to be complete: LookupTable checks coverage on every actual lookup.
globalTypeDemands :: BackendModule -> Set.Set String
globalTypeDemands mod = foldl
  (\acc group -> foldl (\entries (Tuple _ value) -> visit entries value) acc group.bindings)
  (Set.fromFoldable
    [ "Data.Argonaut.Decode.Internal.Record.schemaDecoderABI1"
    , "Data.Argonaut.Decode.Parser.textDecoderABI1"
    , "Data.Argonaut.Decode.Internal.Record.borrowObject"
    , RegexMatchProjection.helperName
    , RegexMatchProjection.adapterName
    ]) mod.bindings
  where
  visit acc (NeutralExpr syntax) = case syntax of
    Var (Qualified (Just owner) (Ident name)) -> Set.insert (unwrap owner <> "." <> name) acc
    _ -> foldl visit acc syntax

foldWorkerReferences :: forall a. (CoreFn.ModuleName -> String -> a -> a) -> a -> BackendModule -> a
foldWorkerReferences insert initial mod = foldl
  (\acc group -> foldl (\entries (Tuple _ value) -> visit entries value) acc group.bindings)
  initial
  mod.bindings
  where
  visit acc (NeutralExpr syntax) = case syntax of
    Var (Qualified (Just owner) (Ident name)) | owner /= mod.name ->
      insert owner name acc
    _ -> foldl visit acc syntax

-- Source metadata must be the same as at preparation. Output supplies the
-- freshly parsed local FFI signatures here. Restrict imported signatures to
-- exactly the snapshot covered by the emission key, including on fresh builds.
translatePreparedWithFunctions :: CodegenMetadata -> PreparedModule -> { code :: String, functions :: ModuleFunctions, file :: GoFile }
translatePreparedWithFunctions sourceMetadata prepared =
  let
    metadata = sourceMetadata { globalFunctions = Map.mapMaybe identity prepared.workers }
    mod = prepared.module
    modNameStrOrig = unwrap mod.name
    modNameStr = String.replaceAll (Pattern ".") (Replacement "_") modNameStrOrig

    codegenStateRef :: Ref CodegenState
    codegenStateRef = unsafePerformEffect $
      Ref.new { declarations: ModuleDeclarations.constructors metadata modNameStr mod, globalId: 0, reboxPairs: Set.empty }

    preparedBindings = ModuleBindings.prepare metadata modNameStr mod
    -- The module's FFI functions are keyed by raw identifier; local functions
    -- take precedence when names collide.
    -- Reserved immediate-effect signatures must never become ordinary local
    -- calls after sanitizing their otherwise impossible PureScript names.
    ffiLocalFunctions = Map.fromFoldable $ Array.mapMaybe
      (\(Tuple (Ident name) _) -> map (Tuple (sanitizeName name)) (Map.lookup name metadata.ffiFunctions))
      (Map.toUnfoldable mod.foreign)
    moduleFunctions = Map.union (Map.union prepared.functions preparedBindings.functions) ffiLocalFunctions
    normalFunctions = Map.fromFoldable $ Array.concatMap
      (\group -> Array.mapMaybe
        (\(Tuple (Ident name) _) -> do
          info <- Map.lookup (sanitizeName name) moduleFunctions
          guard (info.arity >= 1 && info.arity <= 10)
          pure (Tuple (unwrap mod.name <> "." <> name) info))
        group.bindings)
      preparedBindings.bindings
    -- Export FFI functions as `<Module>.<ident>` for callers in other modules.
    ffiGlobalFunctions = Map.fromFoldable $ map
      (\(Tuple name info) -> Tuple (unwrap mod.name <> "." <> name) info)
      (Map.toUnfoldable metadata.ffiFunctions :: Array (Tuple String FunctionInfo))

    Tuple allDeclsAst helpers = unsafePerformEffect do
      let
        d = ModuleBindings.declarations translateExpr metadata codegenStateRef modNameStr moduleFunctions preparedBindings.bindings
      h <- Ref.read codegenStateRef
      pure (Tuple d h)

    foreignGetters = map
      (\(Tuple (Ident name) _) -> GoForeignGetter
        { name: generated modNameStr ("Get_" <> modNameStr <> "_" <> sanitizeName name)
        , value: foreignSymbol modNameStr ("_Gopurs_" <> modNameStr <> "_" <> capitalize (sanitizeName name))
        })
      (Map.toUnfoldable mod.foreign)
    declarationGroups = map (map RecordReadGroups.declaration)
      [ allDeclsAst <> prepared.declarations
      , helpers.declarations <> unsafePerformEffect (generateReboxFunctions metadata codegenStateRef modNameStr)
      , foreignGetters
      ]
    goFile = { packageName: "purescript", imports: collectImports declarationGroups, declarationGroups }

  in
    { code: printGoFile goFile
    , functions: Map.union normalFunctions ffiGlobalFunctions
    , file: goFile
    }

translateExpr :: TranslateExpr
translateExpr context@{ metadata, codegenStateRef, modNameStr, bound, options: { inEffectBlock }, mbExpectedExprType } nextId tcoExpr@(TcoExpr _ expr) =
  let
    child = childContext context Nothing
    isEff = isEffectNode tcoExpr
  in
    if isEff && not inEffectBlock then
      EffectExprs.wrap translateExpr context nextId tcoExpr
    else
      case expr of
        Typed type_ a ->
          TypedExprs.annotated translateExpr context nextId type_ a
        Var (Qualified mbMn (Ident i)) ->
          let
            safeName = sanitizeName i
            vType = case mbMn of
              Just mn ->
                let
                  modStr = unwrap mn
                in
                  case LookupTable.lookup (modStr <> "." <> i) metadata.globalTypes of
                    Just ty -> exprTypeToGoType metadata.sharedRecords metadata.pointerAdtPaths metadata.enumAdts metadata.elidedCtors modNameStr ty
                    Nothing -> TypeValue
              Nothing -> TypeValue
          in
            case mbMn of
              Just mn ->
                let
                  modStr = unwrap mn
                  modPkg = String.replaceAll (Pattern ".") (Replacement "_") modStr
                  rawCall = GoCall (GoRef (SymbolReference (generated modPkg ("Get_" <> modPkg <> "_" <> safeName)))) []
                in
                  { stmts: StmtEmpty, expr: coerceGoExpr codegenStateRef modNameStr rawCall TypeValue vType, exprType: vType, nextId }
              Nothing ->
                let
                  rawCall = GoCall (GoRef (SymbolReference (generated modNameStr ("Get_" <> modNameStr <> "_" <> safeName)))) []
                in
                  { stmts: StmtEmpty, expr: coerceGoExpr codegenStateRef modNameStr rawCall TypeValue vType, exprType: vType, nextId }

        Local mbIdent lvl ->
          let
            v = fromMaybe { name: localId mbIdent lvl, goType: TypeValue } (Map.lookup (localId mbIdent lvl) bound)
          in
            { stmts: StmtEmpty, expr: GoVar v.name, exprType: v.goType, nextId }

        Lit value
          | Just result <- PrimitiveExprs.literal value ->
              { stmts: StmtEmpty, expr: result.expr, exprType: result.exprType, nextId }

        Lit (LitArray xs) ->
          LiteralExprs.array translateExpr context nextId xs

        Lit (LitRecord props) ->
          LiteralExprs.record translateExpr context nextId (getExprType tcoExpr) props

        expr_
          | ( case expr_ of
                App _ _ -> true
                Syn.TypeApp _ _ -> true
                _ -> false
            ) ->
              CallExprs.application translateExpr context nextId tcoExpr

        Abs args body ->
          FunctionExprs.abstraction translateExpr context nextId tcoExpr args body

        UncurriedApp fn args ->
          CallExprs.uncurriedApplication translateExpr context nextId tcoExpr fn args

        UncurriedAbs args body ->
          FunctionExprs.uncurriedAbstraction translateExpr context nextId tcoExpr args body

        UncurriedEffectApp fn args ->
          CallExprs.effectApplication translateExpr context nextId fn args

        UncurriedEffectAbs args body ->
          FunctionExprs.effectAbstraction translateExpr context nextId tcoExpr args body

        EffectBind mbIdent lvl binding body ->
          EffectExprs.bindEffect translateExpr context nextId mbIdent lvl binding body

        EffectPure binding ->
          EffectExprs.pureValue translateExpr context nextId binding

        EffectDefer binding ->
          EffectExprs.defer translateExpr context nextId binding

        Let mbIdent lvl binding body ->
          BindingExprs.nonRecursive translateExpr context nextId mbIdent lvl binding body

        LetRec lvl bindings body ->
          BindingExprs.recursive translateExpr context nextId tcoExpr lvl bindings body

        Accessor obj accessor ->
          let
            resObj = translateExpr child nextId obj
          in
            case accessor of
              GetProp prop ->
                let
                  result = RecordExprs.getProp metadata codegenStateRef modNameStr prop { expr: resObj.expr, exprType: resObj.exprType }
                in
                  { stmts: resObj.stmts, expr: result.expr, exprType: result.exprType, nextId: resObj.nextId }
              GetIndex idx -> { stmts: resObj.stmts, expr: GoCall (GoSelector (GoVar "gopurs_runtime") "ArrayAccess") [ (boxGoExpr codegenStateRef modNameStr resObj.expr resObj.exprType), GoInt idx ], exprType: TypeValue, nextId: resObj.nextId }
              GetCtorField (Qualified mbMod _) _ _ (Ident ctorName) _ idx ->
                let
                  result = AdtExprs.getField metadata codegenStateRef modNameStr
                    { moduleName: mbMod, ctorName, index: idx }
                    { expr: resObj.expr, exprType: resObj.exprType, sourceType: getExprType obj }
                in
                  { stmts: resObj.stmts, expr: result.expr, exprType: result.exprType, nextId: resObj.nextId }

        Update obj props ->
          let
            resObj = translateExpr child nextId obj
            accProps = foldl
              ( \acc (Prop key val) ->
                  let
                    resVal = translateExpr child acc.nextId val
                  in
                    { stmts: acc.stmts <> resVal.stmts, exprs: Array.snoc acc.exprs { key, expr: resVal.expr, goType: resVal.exprType }, exprType: TypeValue, nextId: resVal.nextId }
              )
              { stmts: StmtEmpty, exprs: [], exprType: TypeValue, nextId: resObj.nextId }
              props
            resultType = map (exprTypeToGoType metadata.sharedRecords metadata.pointerAdtPaths metadata.enumAdts metadata.elidedCtors modNameStr) mbExpectedExprType
            result = RecordExprs.update codegenStateRef modNameStr resultType { expr: resObj.expr, exprType: resObj.exprType } accProps.exprs
          in
            { stmts: resObj.stmts <> accProps.stmts, expr: result.expr, exprType: result.exprType, nextId: accProps.nextId }

        CtorDef _ _ (Ident name) fields ->
          ConstructorExprs.definition context nextId tcoExpr name fields

        CtorSaturated (Qualified mbMod _) _ _ (Ident name) props ->
          ConstructorExprs.saturated translateExpr context nextId tcoExpr mbMod name props

        Fail msg ->
          ControlExprs.failure context nextId tcoExpr msg

        Branch branches def ->
          ControlExprs.branch translateExpr context nextId branches def

        PrimOp (Op1 op1 e)
          | Just emit <- PrimitiveExprs.unary codegenStateRef modNameStr op1 ->
              let
                resE = translateExpr child nextId e
                result = emit { expr: resE.expr, exprType: resE.exprType }
              in
                { stmts: resE.stmts, expr: result.expr, exprType: result.exprType, nextId: resE.nextId }

        PrimOp (Op1 (OpIsTag (Qualified mbMod (Ident tag))) e) ->
          let
            -- A pointer ADT's tag is independent of its type arguments. Keep
            -- the operand's representation: coercing a boxed List here would
            -- copy its entire tail merely to distinguish Nil from Cons.
            translateOperand expected operand@(TcoExpr _ syntax) =
              case syntax of
                Typed type_ inner
                  | TypeStructPointer _ <- exprTypeToGoType metadata.sharedRecords metadata.pointerAdtPaths metadata.enumAdts metadata.elidedCtors modNameStr type_ ->
                      translateOperand (Just type_) inner
                _ ->
                  translateExpr (child { mbExpectedExprType = expected }) nextId operand
            resE = translateOperand Nothing e
          in
            AdtExprs.isTag metadata codegenStateRef modNameStr mbMod tag resE

        PrimOp (Op1 OpArrayLength e) ->
          let
            resE = translateExpr child nextId e
          in
            case resE.exprType of
              TypeNativeArray _ -> { stmts: resE.stmts, expr: GoCall (GoSelector (GoVar "gopurs_runtime") "Int") [ GoCall (GoVar "int64") [ GoCall (GoVar "len") [ resE.expr ] ] ], exprType: TypeValue, nextId: resE.nextId }
              _ -> { stmts: resE.stmts, expr: GoCall (GoSelector (GoVar "gopurs_runtime") "Int") [ GoCall (GoVar "int64") [ GoCall (GoSelector (GoVar "gopurs_runtime") "ArrayLength") [ boxGoExpr codegenStateRef modNameStr resE.expr resE.exprType ] ] ], exprType: TypeValue, nextId: resE.nextId }

        PrimOp (Op2 OpBooleanAnd e1 e2) ->
          ControlExprs.booleanAnd translateExpr context nextId e1 e2

        PrimOp (Op2 OpBooleanOr e1 e2) ->
          ControlExprs.booleanOr translateExpr context nextId e1 e2

        PrimOp (Op2 OpArrayIndex e1 e2) ->
          ArrayIntrinsics.unsafeIndex translateExpr context nextId e1 e2

        PrimOp (Op2 op2 e1 e2)
          | Just result <- PrimitiveExprs.stringLengthComparison translateExpr context nextId op2 e1 e2 ->
              result

        PrimOp (Op2 op2 e1 e2)
          | Just result <- PrimitiveExprs.boundedIntProduct translateExpr context nextId op2 e1 e2 ->
              result

        PrimOp (Op2 op2 e1 e2)
          | Just emit <- PrimitiveExprs.binary codegenStateRef modNameStr op2 ->
              let
                res1 = translateExpr child nextId e1
                res2 = translateExpr child res1.nextId e2
                result = emit { expr: res1.expr, exprType: res1.exprType } { expr: res2.expr, exprType: res2.exprType }
              in
                { stmts: res1.stmts <> res2.stmts, expr: result.expr, exprType: result.exprType, nextId: res2.nextId }

        PrimEffect eff ->
          EffectExprs.primitive translateExpr context nextId eff

        _ -> { stmts: StmtEmpty, expr: GoVar "gopurs_runtime.Value{}", exprType: TypeValue, nextId }

module Gopurs.ModuleWorkers (declaration) where

import Prelude
import Data.Array as Array
import Data.Map as Map
import Data.Maybe (Maybe(..))
import Data.Tuple (Tuple(..), fst, snd)
import Effect.Ref as Ref
import Effect.Unsafe (unsafePerformEffect)
import Gopurs.ExprAnalysis (extractExprFuncType, functionResultAfter, getExprType)
import Gopurs.ExprContext (ExprContext, TranslateExpr, bindParameters, flattenStmts)
import Gopurs.GoAst (GoDecl(..), GoExpr(..), GoType(..))
import Gopurs.GoSymbol (GoReference(..), generated)
import Gopurs.GoConversions (boxGoExpr, coerceGoExpr)
import Gopurs.GoFunctions (Parameters, curriedFunction, iterationBindings, loopParameters, namedParameters)
import Gopurs.Int32Loops as Int32Loops
import Gopurs.AffineLoops as AffineLoops
import Gopurs.ArraySnoc as ArraySnoc
import Gopurs.ListFilter as ListFilter
import Gopurs.TailAddLoops as TailAddLoops
import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.Codegen.Tco (TcoExpr)

type Worker =
  { ident :: String
  , args :: Array String
  , body :: TcoExpr
  , val :: TcoExpr
  }

-- Use precisely the ABI published by ModuleBindings, including native record
-- projections. A self-recursive singleton gets a loop; peers in larger groups
-- remain ordinary calls. Module bodies begin with no captured local bindings.
declaration :: TranslateExpr -> ExprContext -> Boolean -> Worker -> GoDecl
declaration translate context@{ codegenStateRef, modNameStr, moduleFunctions } isSelfRecursive fn =
  let
    info = Map.lookup fn.ident moduleFunctions
    params = namedParameters fn.args (case info of
      Just signature -> signature.fArgs
      Nothing -> [])
    expectedBodyType = map (functionResultAfter (Array.length fn.args)) (extractExprFuncType (getExprType fn.val))
    loop = if isSelfRecursive then
      [ { ident: fn.ident, loopParams: map fst (loopParameters params), goTypes: map snd params } ]
      else []
    workerContext = context
      { depth = 0
      , bound = bindParameters params Map.empty
      , tcoIdent = Just fn.ident
      , loopCtx = loop
      , options = { isTail: isSelfRecursive, inEffectBlock: false }
      , mbExpectedExprType = expectedBodyType
      , mbExpectedGoType = if Array.null fn.args || resultType == TypeValue then Nothing else Just resultType
      }
    resultType = case info of
      Just signature | Array.length fn.args < Array.length signature.fArgs -> TypeValue
      Just signature -> signature.fRet
      Nothing -> TypeValue
    tailAdd = if isSelfRecursive then
      TailAddLoops.worker translate workerContext fn.ident params resultType fn.body
      else Nothing
    body boxed = case tailAdd of
      Just loopBody -> loopBody
      Nothing ->
        let
          native = case ListFilter.worker context.metadata params resultType fn.val of
            Just filtered -> Just filtered
            Nothing -> ArraySnoc.worker modNameStr fn.ident params resultType fn.body
          result = case native of
            Just lowered -> lowered
            Nothing -> translate workerContext 0 fn.body
          returning = if boxed then boxGoExpr codegenStateRef modNameStr result.expr result.exprType
            else coerceGoExpr codegenStateRef modNameStr result.expr result.exprType resultType
          statements = flattenStmts result.stmts <> [ GoReturn returning ]
        in if isSelfRecursive then
          AffineLoops.wrap translate workerContext (AffineLoops.globalTarget modNameStr fn.ident) params resultType fn.body
            (Int32Loops.loop fn.ident params resultType statements)
          else GoBlock (iterationBindings params <> statements)
    value = if Array.null fn.args then
      -- A zero-argument abstraction still defers its whole body until called.
      curriedFunction [ Tuple "_" TypeValue ] TypeValue
        (body true)
      else
        let
          worker = GoFunctionDecl
            { name: generated modNameStr ("Call_" <> modNameStr <> "_" <> fn.ident)
            , params: loopParameters params
            , result: resultType
            , body: body false
            }
        in
          unsafePerformEffect do
            Ref.modify_ (\state -> state { declarations = Array.snoc state.declarations worker }) codegenStateRef
            pure (boxedWrapper context fn.ident params resultType)
  in
    GoCachedValue { identifier: generated modNameStr (modNameStr <> "_" <> fn.ident), expression: value, goType: TypeValue }

-- Module wrappers group up to ten arguments; larger arities keep unary layers.
-- LocalWorkers and anonymous closures retain their own grouping policies.
boxedWrapper :: ExprContext -> String -> Parameters -> GoType -> GoExpr
boxedWrapper { codegenStateRef, modNameStr } name params resultType =
  let
    wrapperParams = map (\(Tuple param _) -> param <> "_box") params
    call = GoCall (GoRef (SymbolReference (generated modNameStr ("Call_" <> modNameStr <> "_" <> name))))
      (map (\(Tuple param ty) -> coerceGoExpr codegenStateRef modNameStr (GoVar (param <> "_box")) TypeValue ty) params)
    boxed = boxGoExpr codegenStateRef modNameStr call resultType
    arity = Array.length params
    wrapperName = if arity == 1 then "gopurs_runtime.Func" else "gopurs_runtime.Func" <> show arity
  in
    if arity <= 10 then
      GoCall (GoVar wrapperName) [ GoFuncLit (map (\param -> Tuple param TypeValue) wrapperParams) [] boxed TypeValue ]
    else Array.foldr
      (\param inner -> GoCall (GoSelector (GoVar "gopurs_runtime") "Func")
        [ GoFuncLit [ Tuple param TypeValue ] [] inner TypeValue ])
      boxed wrapperParams

module Gopurs.AdtExprs
  ( AdtExpr
  , definition
  , SaturatedConstructor
  , prepareSaturated
  , prepareSaturatedAs
  , saturatedFieldType
  , saturated
  , getField
  , isTag
  , constructorReuse
  ) where

import Prelude

import Control.Alternative (guard)

import Data.Array as Array
import Data.Map as Map
import Data.Maybe (Maybe(..), fromMaybe)
import Data.Set as Set
import Data.Tuple (Tuple(..))
import Effect.Ref (Ref)
import Gopurs.CodegenState (CodegenMetadata, CodegenState)
import Gopurs.ExprContext (ExprResult, LocalEnv, StmtTree(..))
import Gopurs.GoAst (rawGo, GoExpr(..), GoType(..), goTypeToStr, sanitizeName, getStructName)
import Gopurs.GoConversions (boxGoExpr, coerceGoExpr, unboxGoExpr, unboxableADTs)
import Gopurs.GoTypes (exprTypeToGoType, instantiateGenericGoType, structFieldGoType)
import Gopurs.ConstructorLayout (PreparedConstructor)
import Gopurs.ConstructorLayout as ConstructorLayout
import Gopurs.Printer (printGoExpr)
import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.CoreFn (ExprType(..), ModuleName(..))
import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.FfiSupport (hashString)

type AdtExpr =
  { expr :: GoExpr
  , exprType :: GoType
  }

-- The caller supplies the constructor's result type after resolving annotations
-- and function wrappers; metadata determines its native representation.
definition :: CodegenMetadata -> Ref CodegenState -> String -> String -> Array String -> ExprType -> AdtExpr
definition metadata codegenStateRef modNameStr name fields ctorType =
  let
    prepared = ConstructorLayout.prepare ConstructorLayout.Definition metadata modNameStr modNameStr name ctorType
    { identity, fields: fieldInfo } = prepared.layout
    { structName, baseStructName } = identity
    typeArgs = prepared.typeArgs
    coercedFields = Array.mapWithIndex
      (\i f -> coerceGoExpr codegenStateRef modNameStr (GoVar (sanitizeName f)) TypeValue
        (ConstructorLayout.fieldType metadata modNameStr fieldInfo prepared.fieldTypeArgs i))
      fields
    isElided = Set.member structName metadata.elidedCtors
    isEnum = Set.member baseStructName metadata.enumCtors
    boxedCtor = boxGoExpr codegenStateRef modNameStr
      (GoConstructor (hashString baseStructName) identity.symbol typeArgs coercedFields) prepared.pointerType
    finalExprType =
      if isEnum then TypeUint32
      else case prepared.leafPointerType of
        Just pointer -> pointer
        Nothing -> if Array.null fields then prepared.pointerType else TypeValue

    funcExpr =
      if isElided then
        case Array.head fields of
          Just f -> GoCall (GoSelector (GoVar "gopurs_runtime") "Func") [ GoFuncLit [ Tuple (sanitizeName f) TypeValue ] [] (coerceGoExpr codegenStateRef modNameStr (GoVar (sanitizeName f)) TypeValue TypeValue) TypeValue ]
          Nothing -> Array.foldr (\f inner -> GoCall (GoSelector (GoVar "gopurs_runtime") "Func") [ GoFuncLit [ Tuple (sanitizeName f) TypeValue ] [] inner TypeValue ]) boxedCtor fields
      else case prepared.leafPointerType of
        Just pointer -> rawGo ("(" <> goTypeToStr pointer <> ")(nil)")
        Nothing ->
          if isEnum then rawGo (hashString baseStructName)
          else if Array.null fields then GoConstructor (hashString baseStructName) identity.symbol typeArgs coercedFields
          else Array.foldr (\f inner -> GoCall (GoSelector (GoVar "gopurs_runtime") "Func") [ GoFuncLit [ Tuple (sanitizeName f) TypeValue ] [] inner TypeValue ]) boxedCtor fields

  in
    { expr: funcExpr, exprType: finalExprType }

-- Opaque preparation shared by field typing and final construction. The
-- immutable metadata is shared while child expressions register conversions.
newtype SaturatedConstructor = SaturatedConstructor
  { metadata :: CodegenMetadata
  , modNameStr :: String
  , name :: String
  , prepared :: PreparedConstructor
  , nativeTuplePointer :: Boolean
  , nativeArrayMaybePointer :: Boolean
  }

prepareSaturated :: CodegenMetadata -> String -> Maybe ModuleName -> String -> ExprType -> SaturatedConstructor
prepareSaturated metadata modNameStr mbMod name ctorType =
  prepareSaturatedAs metadata modNameStr mbMod name ctorType Nothing

prepareSaturatedAs :: CodegenMetadata -> String -> Maybe ModuleName -> String -> ExprType -> Maybe GoType -> SaturatedConstructor
prepareSaturatedAs metadata modNameStr mbMod name ctorType expected =
  let
    fallbackModule = case mbMod of
      Just (ModuleName mn) -> mn
      Nothing -> modNameStr
    prepared = ConstructorLayout.withExpectedRepresentation expected
      (ConstructorLayout.prepare ConstructorLayout.Saturated metadata modNameStr fallbackModule name ctorType)
    -- A Tuple consumer can require a typed pointer rather than the ordinary
    -- struct-value ABI. Preserve that choice through field translation and
    -- construction, so composite fields are not boxed and traversed again.
    nativeTuplePointer = case expected, prepared.pointerType of
      Just (TypeStructPointer target), TypeStructPointer source ->
        prepared.adtFullName == Just "Data.Tuple.Tuple" && name == "Tuple"
          && Array.length source.typeArgs == 2
          && source.baseStructName == target.baseStructName
          && source.fullPath == target.fullPath
          && source.symbol == target.symbol
          && source.typeArgs == target.typeArgs
      _, _ -> false
    -- An explicitly requested canonical Maybe (Array Int) pointer keeps its
    -- buffer native. The ordinary sum ABI still uses Value payloads.
    nativeArrayMaybePointer = case expected, fromMaybe prepared.pointerType prepared.leafPointerType of
      Just (TypeStructPointer target), TypeStructPointer source ->
        prepared.adtFullName == Just "Data.Maybe.Maybe"
          && ctorType == ADT "Data.Maybe.Maybe" [ "Data", "Maybe", "Maybe" ] [ Array Int ]
          && (name == "Just" || name == "Nothing")
          && source.typeArgs == [ TypeNativeArray TypeInt64 ]
          && source.baseStructName == target.baseStructName
          && source.fullPath == target.fullPath
          && source.symbol == target.symbol
          && source.fullName == target.fullName
          && source.typeArgs == target.typeArgs
      _, _ -> false
  in
    SaturatedConstructor { metadata, modNameStr, name, prepared, nativeTuplePointer, nativeArrayMaybePointer }

saturatedFieldType :: SaturatedConstructor -> Int -> { exprType :: ExprType, goType :: GoType }
saturatedFieldType (SaturatedConstructor { metadata, modNameStr, prepared, nativeTuplePointer, nativeArrayMaybePointer }) fieldIdx =
  let
    expectedExprType = fromMaybe Any (Array.index prepared.layout.fields.fields fieldIdx)
    fallbackType = ConstructorLayout.fieldType metadata modNameStr prepared.layout.fields prepared.fieldTypeArgs fieldIdx
    expectedType = if nativeTuplePointer || nativeArrayMaybePointer then fallbackType else case prepared.adtFullName >>= \fn -> Map.lookup fn unboxableADTs of
      Just adt ->
        let
          signature = adt.signature prepared.typeArgs
        in
          case adt.fieldIndex prepared.layout.identity.baseStructName fieldIdx >>= \slot -> Array.index signature slot of
            Just slotType -> slotType
            Nothing -> fallbackType
      Nothing -> fallbackType
  in
    { exprType: expectedExprType, goType: expectedType }

-- Fields arrive in source order, already translated and immediately coerced.
-- ConstructorExprs owns reuse and statement assembly after field translation.
saturated :: Ref CodegenState -> SaturatedConstructor -> { exprs :: Array GoExpr, exprTypes :: Array GoType } -> AdtExpr
saturated codegenStateRef (SaturatedConstructor { metadata, modNameStr, name, prepared, nativeTuplePointer, nativeArrayMaybePointer }) accProps =
  let
    { structName, baseStructName } = prepared.layout.identity
    native =
      { expr: GoConstructor (hashString baseStructName) prepared.layout.identity.symbol prepared.typeArgs accProps.exprs
      , exprType: prepared.pointerType
      }
  in
    if Set.member structName metadata.elidedCtors then
      case Array.head accProps.exprs of
        -- Fields have already been coerced to their instantiated representation.
        Just expr -> { expr: boxGoExpr codegenStateRef modNameStr expr (fromMaybe TypeValue (Array.head accProps.exprTypes)), exprType: TypeValue }
        Nothing -> native
    else if nativeTuplePointer then native
    else if nativeArrayMaybePointer then case prepared.leafPointerType of
      Just pointer -> { expr: rawGo ("(" <> goTypeToStr pointer <> ")(nil)"), exprType: pointer }
      Nothing -> native
    else case prepared.adtFullName >>= \fn -> Map.lookup fn unboxableADTs >>= \adt -> Just (Tuple fn adt) of
      Just (Tuple fn adt) ->
        let
          signature = adt.signature prepared.typeArgs
        in
          { expr: GoStructValue fn signature (adt.mapConstructor prepared.typeArgs name accProps.exprs)
          , exprType: TypeStructValue fn signature
          }
      Nothing -> case prepared.leafPointerType of
        Just pointer -> { expr: rawGo ("(" <> goTypeToStr pointer <> ")(nil)"), exprType: pointer }
        Nothing ->
          if Set.member baseStructName metadata.enumCtors then { expr: rawGo (hashString baseStructName), exprType: TypeUint32 }
          else native

-- The object's statements and identifiers remain with the caller.
getField
  :: CodegenMetadata
  -> Ref CodegenState
  -> String
  -> { moduleName :: Maybe ModuleName, ctorName :: String, index :: Int }
  -> { expr :: GoExpr, exprType :: GoType, sourceType :: ExprType }
  -> AdtExpr
getField metadata codegenStateRef modNameStr { moduleName: mbMod, ctorName, index: idx } object =
  let
    nativeField = case object.exprType of
      TypeStructValue adtName signature -> do
        adt <- Map.lookup adtName unboxableADTs
        slot <- adt.fieldIndex (getStructName modNameStr mbMod ctorName) idx
        fieldType <- Array.index signature slot
        pure { expr: GoSelector object.expr ("V" <> show slot), exprType: fieldType }
      _ -> Nothing
  in
    case nativeField of
      Just result -> result
      Nothing -> getBoxedField
  where
  getBoxedField =
    let
      defMod = case mbMod of
        Just (ModuleName mod) -> mod
        Nothing -> modNameStr
      ctorLayout = ConstructorLayout.layout metadata defMod ctorName Nothing
      { structName } = ctorLayout.identity
    in if Set.member structName metadata.elidedCtors then
      { expr: coerceGoExpr codegenStateRef modNameStr object.expr object.exprType TypeValue, exprType: TypeValue }
    else
      let
        fields = fromMaybe [] (map _.fields ctorLayout.constructorFields)
        monoStructName = ctorLayout.identity.symbol

        expectedType = case Array.index fields idx of
          Just ty -> exprTypeToGoType metadata.sharedRecords metadata.pointerAdtPaths metadata.enumAdts metadata.elidedCtors modNameStr ty
          Nothing -> TypeValue

        typeArgs = case object.exprType of
          TypeStructPointer { typeArgs: tArgs } -> tArgs
          _ -> ConstructorLayout.typeArguments metadata modNameStr Nothing
            (fromMaybe [] (map _.vars ctorLayout.constructorFields)) object.sourceType

        isNative = case object.exprType of
          TypeStructPointer _ -> true
          _ -> false

        actualFieldType = case object.exprType of
          TypeStructPointer { typeArgs: tArgs } ->
            case ctorLayout.constructorFields of
              Just ctorInfo ->
                let
                  env = Map.fromFoldable (Array.zip ctorInfo.vars tArgs)
                  genericTy = structFieldGoType metadata.sharedRecords metadata.pointerAdtPaths metadata.enumAdts metadata.elidedCtors ctorInfo.vars modNameStr (fromMaybe (TypeVar "") (Array.index fields idx))
                in
                  instantiateGenericGoType env genericTy
              Nothing -> expectedType
          _ -> expectedType

        exprAccess =
          if isNative then
            GoConstructorAccess object.expr monoStructName typeArgs idx true
          else
            GoConstructorAccess (boxGoExpr codegenStateRef modNameStr object.expr object.exprType) monoStructName typeArgs idx false
      in
        { expr: exprAccess, exprType: actualFieldType }

-- Reuse an unchanged constructor without mutating it. Restrict this to direct
-- projections of one typed local, with exactly one constant field replaced.
-- Comparing Number fields would be unsound for observable signed zero.
constructorReuse :: LocalEnv -> GoType -> Array Boolean -> GoExpr -> Maybe { source :: GoExpr, condition :: GoExpr }
constructorReuse bound resultType constants constructor = case resultType, constructor of
  TypeStructPointer _, GoConstructor _ ctor typeArgs fields ->
    case Array.catMaybes (Array.mapWithIndex (\index constant -> if constant then Just index else Nothing) constants) of
      [ changedIndex ] -> do
        guard (Array.length constants == Array.length fields)
        sourceName <- Array.head
          ( Array.mapMaybe
              ( \(Tuple index field) -> case field of
                  GoConstructorAccess (GoVar name) sourceCtor sourceTypeArgs sourceIndex true
                    | index /= changedIndex && sourceCtor == ctor
                        && sourceTypeArgs == typeArgs
                        && sourceIndex == index -> Just name
                  _ -> Nothing
              )
              (Array.mapWithIndex Tuple fields)
          )
        sourceBinding <- Array.find (\binding -> binding.name == sourceName)
          (Array.fromFoldable (Map.values bound))
        guard (sourceBinding.goType == resultType)
        let
          source = GoVar sourceName
          projection index = GoConstructorAccess source ctor typeArgs index true
        guard
          ( Array.all identity
              ( Array.mapWithIndex
                  (\index field -> index == changedIndex || field == projection index)
                  fields
              )
          )
        replacement <- Array.index fields changedIndex
        pure
          { source
          , condition: GoBinOp "&&" (GoBinOp "!=" source (rawGo "nil"))
              (GoBinOp "==" (projection changedIndex) replacement)
          }
      _ -> Nothing
  _, _ -> Nothing

-- The operand has already been translated. A temporary keeps non-variable
-- operands evaluated exactly once, including constant native tag tests.
isTag :: CodegenMetadata -> Ref CodegenState -> String -> Maybe ModuleName -> String -> ExprResult -> ExprResult
isTag metadata codegenStateRef modNameStr mbMod tag resE =
  let
    baseStructName = getStructName modNameStr mbMod tag
    hashStr = hashString baseStructName
    nativeTagTest = case resE.exprType of
      TypeStructValue adtName _ -> map (\adt -> adt.isConstructor baseStructName) (Map.lookup adtName unboxableADTs)
      _ -> Nothing

    isNativePointer = case resE.exprType of
      TypeStructPointer { baseStructName: typedBaseStructName } ->
        typedBaseStructName == baseStructName ||
          ( case Map.lookup baseStructName metadata.pointerAdtLeaves of
              Just nodeInfo -> typedBaseStructName == nodeInfo.nodeBaseStruct
              Nothing -> false
          )
      _ -> false
  in
    case resE.expr of
      GoVar _ ->
        let
          exprStr = case nativeTagTest of
            Just test -> printGoExpr (test resE.expr)
            Nothing ->
              if isNativePointer then
                case Map.lookup baseStructName metadata.pointerAdtLeaves of
                  Just _ -> "(" <> printGoExpr resE.expr <> " == nil)"
                  Nothing -> "(" <> printGoExpr resE.expr <> " != nil)"
              else case Map.lookup baseStructName metadata.pointerAdtLeaves of
                Just nodeInfo -> "(" <> printGoExpr (boxGoExpr codegenStateRef modNameStr resE.expr resE.exprType) <> ".Type == 9 && " <> printGoExpr (boxGoExpr codegenStateRef modNameStr resE.expr resE.exprType) <> ".IntVal == " <> hashString nodeInfo.nodeBaseStruct <> " && " <> printGoExpr (boxGoExpr codegenStateRef modNameStr resE.expr resE.exprType) <> ".UnsafePtr == nil)"
                Nothing ->
                  if Set.member baseStructName metadata.pointerAdtNodes then
                    "(" <> printGoExpr (boxGoExpr codegenStateRef modNameStr resE.expr resE.exprType) <> ".Type == 9 && " <> printGoExpr (boxGoExpr codegenStateRef modNameStr resE.expr resE.exprType) <> ".IntVal == " <> hashStr <> " && " <> printGoExpr (boxGoExpr codegenStateRef modNameStr resE.expr resE.exprType) <> ".UnsafePtr != nil)"
                  else if Set.member baseStructName metadata.enumCtors then
                    "(" <> printGoExpr (unboxGoExpr codegenStateRef modNameStr resE.expr resE.exprType TypeUint32) <> " == " <> hashStr <> ")"
                  else
                    "(" <> printGoExpr (boxGoExpr codegenStateRef modNameStr resE.expr resE.exprType) <> ".Type == 9 && " <> printGoExpr (boxGoExpr codegenStateRef modNameStr resE.expr resE.exprType) <> ".IntVal == " <> hashStr <> ")"
        in
          { stmts: resE.stmts, expr: rawGo exprStr, exprType: TypeBool, nextId: resE.nextId }
      _ ->
        let
          tmpVar = "__t_tag_" <> show resE.nextId
          declTmp =
            if isNativePointer || resE.exprType /= TypeValue then
              StmtLeaf (rawGo ("var " <> tmpVar <> " " <> goTypeToStr resE.exprType <> " = " <> printGoExpr resE.expr))
            else
              StmtLeaf (rawGo ("var " <> tmpVar <> " gopurs_runtime.Value = " <> printGoExpr (boxGoExpr codegenStateRef modNameStr resE.expr resE.exprType)))

          exprStr = case nativeTagTest of
            Just test -> printGoExpr (test (GoVar tmpVar))
            Nothing ->
              if isNativePointer then
                case Map.lookup baseStructName metadata.pointerAdtLeaves of
                  Just _ -> "(" <> tmpVar <> " == nil)"
                  Nothing -> "(" <> tmpVar <> " != nil)"
              else if resE.exprType /= TypeValue then
                "(uint32(" <> tmpVar <> ") == " <> hashStr <> ")"
              else case Map.lookup baseStructName metadata.pointerAdtLeaves of
                Just nodeInfo -> "(" <> tmpVar <> ".Type == 9 && " <> tmpVar <> ".IntVal == " <> hashString nodeInfo.nodeBaseStruct <> " && " <> tmpVar <> ".UnsafePtr == nil)"
                Nothing ->
                  if Set.member baseStructName metadata.pointerAdtNodes then
                    "(" <> tmpVar <> ".Type == 9 && " <> tmpVar <> ".IntVal == " <> hashStr <> " && " <> tmpVar <> ".UnsafePtr != nil)"
                  else if Set.member baseStructName metadata.enumCtors then
                    "(" <> printGoExpr (unboxGoExpr codegenStateRef modNameStr (GoVar tmpVar) TypeValue TypeUint32) <> " == " <> hashStr <> ")"
                  else
                    "(" <> tmpVar <> ".Type == 9 && " <> tmpVar <> ".IntVal == " <> hashStr <> ")"
        in
          -- A single-constructor native value has a constant test,
          -- but its operand must still be evaluated exactly once.
          { stmts: resE.stmts <> declTmp <> StmtLeaf (rawGo ("_ = " <> tmpVar)), expr: rawGo exprStr, exprType: TypeBool, nextId: resE.nextId + 1 }

module Gopurs.ArrayConcat (nativeArgument) where

import Prelude

import Control.Alternative (guard)
import Data.Array as Array
import Data.Maybe (Maybe(..), fromMaybe)
import Data.Tuple (Tuple(..))
import Gopurs.ArrayIntrinsics.Source (arraySource)
import Gopurs.CallAnalysis (collectGoSpine, getGoSpineArgs, qualifiedTarget)
import Gopurs.CallArguments as CallArguments
import Gopurs.ExprAnalysis (getExprType)
import Gopurs.ExprContext (ExprContext, ExprResult, TranslateExpr, childContext, flattenStmts, StmtTree(..))
import Gopurs.GoAst (GoExpr(..), GoType(..), rawGo)
import Gopurs.GoConversions (coerceGoExpr)
import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.Codegen.Tco (TcoExpr)
import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.CoreFn (ExprType(..), ModuleName(..))

-- Only a concrete native consumer asks for this representation. Both array
-- values are evaluated before either buffer is read, exactly as in concat's
-- saturated FFI call. In particular, evaluating the right input may mutate a
-- boxed left input through foreign code; no early unboxing is permitted.
nativeArgument :: TranslateExpr -> ExprContext -> Int -> TcoExpr -> Maybe ExprResult
nativeArgument translate context nextId expression = do
  let Tuple function spine = collectGoSpine expression
  target <- qualifiedTarget function
  guard (target.mbMod == Just (ModuleName "Data.Semigroup") && target.name == "concatArray")
  let args = getGoSpineArgs spine
  guard (Array.length args == 2)
  guard (getExprType expression == Array Int)
  let
    captured = CallArguments.capture { prefix: "concatInt_arg_", markUsed: false }
      (\_ currentId argument -> translate (childContext context Nothing) currentId argument) nextId args
    suffix = show captured.nextId
    source argumentIndex =
      let name = "concatInt_source_" <> show argumentIndex <> "_" <> suffix
          inputName = case Array.index captured.exprs argumentIndex of
            Just (GoVar variable) -> variable
            _ -> ""
      in arraySource inputName name (fromMaybe TypeValue (Array.index captured.exprTypes argumentIndex))
    left = source 0
    right = source 1
    output = "concatInt_output_" <> suffix
    offset = "concatInt_offset_" <> suffix
    index = "concatInt_index_" <> suffix
    value = "concatInt_value_" <> suffix
    lengthOf targetName = GoCall (GoVar "len") [ rawGo targetName ]
    copy sourceInfo = GoForRange (index <> ", " <> value <> " := range " <> sourceInfo.target)
      [ GoMutate (output <> "[" <> offset <> "+" <> index <> "]")
          (coerceGoExpr context.codegenStateRef context.modNameStr (GoVar value) sourceInfo.elementType TypeInt64) ]
    body = flattenStmts captured.stmts <>
      [ left.assignment, right.assignment
      , GoAssign output (GoCall (GoVar "make") [ rawGo "[]int64", GoBinOp "+" (lengthOf left.target) (lengthOf right.target) ])
      , GoAssign offset (GoInt 0)
      , copy left
      , GoMutate offset (lengthOf left.target)
      , copy right
      ]
  pure
    { stmts: StmtEmpty
    , expr: GoCall (GoFuncLit [] body (GoVar output) (TypeNativeArray TypeInt64)) []
    , exprType: TypeNativeArray TypeInt64
    , nextId: captured.nextId + 1
    }

module Gopurs.ArrayIndexedFold (emit, readOnlyScalar, integerCallback) where

import Prelude

import Control.Alternative (guard)
import Data.Array as Array
import Data.Array.NonEmpty as NEA
import Data.Foldable (all)
import Data.Map as Map
import Data.Maybe (Maybe(..), fromMaybe)
import Data.Tuple (Tuple(..))
import Gopurs.ArrayIntrinsics.Source (arraySource)
import Gopurs.CallAnalysis (collectCurriedAbs, qualifiedTarget)
import Gopurs.CallArguments as CallArguments
import Gopurs.ExprAnalysis (extractFuncType, getExprType, unwrapTcoExpr)
import Gopurs.ExprContext (ExprContext, ExprResult, StmtTree(..), TranslateExpr, bindParameters, childContext, flattenStmts)
import Gopurs.GoAst (GoExpr(..), GoType(..), rawGo)
import Gopurs.GoConversions (boxGoExpr, coerceGoExpr)
import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.Codegen.Tco (TcoExpr(..))
import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.CoreFn (ExprType(..), Literal(..), ModuleName(..))
import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.FreeVars (localId)
import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.Syntax (BackendOperator(..), BackendOperator1(..), BackendOperator2(..), BackendSyntax(..), Level, Pair(..))

-- The generic FFI adapter copies the source array. Reading it directly is safe
-- only if the callback cannot mutate it through an alias. This proof admits
-- primitive scalar work, not arbitrary calls merely carrying a pure type.
-- All primitive arithmetic keeps its existing semantics. The fold invokes each
-- callback in strict ascending order; no totality assumption is needed.
readOnlyScalar :: Array Level -> TcoExpr -> Boolean
readOnlyScalar locals expression = scalarType (Map.fromFoldable (map (\level -> Tuple level Int) locals)) expression == Just Int

scalarType :: Map.Map Level ExprType -> TcoExpr -> Maybe ExprType
scalarType locals expression = do
  inferred <- case unwrapTcoExpr expression of
    Local _ level -> case Map.lookup level locals of
      Just ty -> Just ty
      Nothing -> let ty = getExprType expression in if ty == Int || ty == Boolean then Just ty else Nothing
    Lit (LitInt _) -> Just Int
    Lit (LitBoolean _) -> Just Boolean
    PrimOp (Op1 operator value) -> do
      ty <- if operator == OpBooleanNot then Just Boolean
        else if operator == OpIntNegate || operator == OpIntBitNot then Just Int else Nothing
      guard (scalarType locals value == Just ty)
      pure ty
    PrimOp (Op2 operator left right) -> do
      signature <- scalarOperator operator
      guard (scalarType locals left == Just signature.operand && scalarType locals right == Just signature.operand)
      pure signature.result
    Branch branches otherwise -> do
      ty <- scalarType locals otherwise
      guard (all (\(Pair condition result) -> scalarType locals condition == Just Boolean && scalarType locals result == Just ty) branches)
      pure ty
    Let _ level value body -> do
      ty <- scalarType locals value
      scalarType (Map.insert level ty locals) body
    _ -> Nothing
  let annotated = getExprType expression
  guard (annotated == Any || annotated == inferred)
  pure inferred

scalarOperator :: BackendOperator2 -> Maybe { operand :: ExprType, result :: ExprType }
scalarOperator = case _ of
  OpIntNum _ -> integer
  OpIntOrd _ -> Just { operand: Int, result: Boolean }
  OpBooleanOrd _ -> boolean
  OpBooleanAnd -> boolean
  OpBooleanOr -> boolean
  OpIntBitAnd -> integer
  OpIntBitOr -> integer
  OpIntBitXor -> integer
  OpIntBitShiftLeft -> integer
  OpIntBitShiftRight -> integer
  OpIntBitZeroFillShiftRight -> integer
  _ -> Nothing
  where
  integer = Just { operand: Int, result: Int }
  boolean = Just { operand: Boolean, result: Boolean }

-- PBO may leave the first lambda unannotated while retaining the exact TAST
-- type of its suffix. The canonical indexed-fold contract proves that first
-- parameter is Int; the suffix must still prove both other parameters/result.
-- An explicit incompatible outer function type is never overridden.
integerCallback :: TcoExpr -> Boolean
integerCallback callback = case extractFuncType callback of
  Just signature -> signature.fArgs == [ Int, Int, Int ] && signature.fRet == Int
  Nothing -> case callback of
    TcoExpr _ (Typed _ _) -> false
    _ -> case unwrapTcoExpr callback of
      Abs parameters body | NEA.length parameters == 1 -> case extractFuncType body of
        Just signature -> signature.fArgs == [ Int, Int ] && signature.fRet == Int
        Nothing -> false
      _ -> false

emit :: TranslateExpr -> ExprContext -> Int -> TcoExpr -> Array TcoExpr -> Maybe ExprResult
emit translate context nextId fn args = do
  target <- qualifiedTarget fn
  guard (target.mbMod == Just (ModuleName "Data.FoldableWithIndex") && target.name == "foldlWithIndexImpl")
  guard (Array.length args == 2 || Array.length args == 3)
  guard (Array.null context.recVars)
  callback <- Array.head args
  guard (integerCallback callback)
  case unwrapTcoExpr callback of
    Abs parameters result -> do
      let grouped = collectCurriedAbs parameters result
      guard (NEA.length grouped.args == 3)
      guard (readOnlyScalar (map (\(Tuple _ level) -> level) (NEA.toArray grouped.args)) grouped.body)
      let
        params = map (\(Tuple name level) -> Tuple (localId name level) TypeInt64) (NEA.toArray grouped.args)
        callbackContext = context
          { depth = context.depth + 1
          , bound = bindParameters params context.bound
          , tcoIdent = Nothing
          , loopCtx = []
          , options = { isTail: true, inEffectBlock: false }
          , mbExpectedExprType = Just Int
          , mbExpectedGoType = Just TypeInt64
          }
        translateArgument index currentId value = if index == 0 then
          let translatedBody = translate callbackContext currentId grouped.body
          in { stmts: StmtEmpty
             , expr: GoFuncLit params (flattenStmts translatedBody.stmts) (integer translatedBody.expr translatedBody.exprType) TypeInt64
             , exprType: TypeFunc [ TypeInt64, TypeInt64, TypeInt64 ] TypeInt64
             , nextId: translatedBody.nextId
             }
          -- Preserve an already native array. TypedExprs also preserves boxed
          -- composite inputs here, so this does not force an array conversion.
          else translate (childContext context Nothing) currentId value
        -- Captures preserve callback/seed/input order. With two arguments the
        -- first two are evaluated now; each later invocation gets a fresh acc.
        captured = CallArguments.capture { prefix: "indexedFold_arg_", markUsed: true } translateArgument nextId args
        argument index = fromMaybe (rawGo "nil") (Array.index captured.exprs index)
        argumentType index = fromMaybe TypeValue (Array.index captured.exprTypes index)
        suffix = show captured.nextId
        inputName = "indexedFold_input_" <> suffix
        valuesName = "indexedFold_values_" <> suffix
        resultName = "indexedFold_result_" <> suffix
        indexName = "indexedFold_index_" <> suffix
        valueName = "indexedFold_value_" <> suffix
        complete = Array.length args == 3
        source = arraySource inputName valuesName (if complete then argumentType 2 else TypeValue)
        body =
          (if complete then [ GoAssign inputName (argument 2) ] else []) <>
          [ source.assignment
          , GoAssign resultName (integer (argument 1) (argumentType 1))
          , GoForRange (indexName <> ", " <> valueName <> " := range " <> source.target)
              [ GoMutate resultName (GoCall (argument 0)
                  [ GoCall (GoVar "int64") [ GoVar indexName ], GoVar resultName, integer (GoVar valueName) source.elementType ]) ]
          ]
        resultExpr = GoVar resultName
        expression = if complete then GoCall (GoFuncLit [] body resultExpr TypeInt64) []
          else GoCall (GoSelector (GoVar "gopurs_runtime") "Func")
            [ GoFuncLit [ Tuple inputName TypeValue ] body
                (boxGoExpr context.codegenStateRef context.modNameStr resultExpr TypeInt64) TypeValue ]
      pure { stmts: captured.stmts, expr: expression, exprType: if complete then TypeInt64 else TypeValue, nextId: captured.nextId + 1 }
    _ -> Nothing
  where
  integer expression from = coerceGoExpr context.codegenStateRef context.modNameStr expression from TypeInt64

module Gopurs.ArrayTraverseTotal (emit, totalIntegerMaybe) where

import Prelude

import Control.Alternative (guard)
import Data.Array as Array
import Data.Array.NonEmpty as NEA
import Data.Foldable (all, foldr)
import Data.Maybe (Maybe(..), fromMaybe)
import Data.Tuple (Tuple(..))
import Gopurs.AdtExprs as AdtExprs
import Gopurs.CallAnalysis (collectCurriedAbs)
import Gopurs.CallArguments as CallArguments
import Gopurs.ExprAnalysis (extractFuncType, getExprType, unwrapTcoExpr)
import Gopurs.ExprContext (ExprContext, ExprResult, StmtTree(..), TranslateExpr, bindParameters, childContext, flattenStmts)
import Gopurs.GoAst (GoExpr(..), GoType(..), goTypeToStr, rawGo)
import Gopurs.GoConversions (boxGoExpr, coerceGoExpr)
import Gopurs.GoTypes (exprTypeToGoType)
import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.Codegen.Tco (TcoExpr)
import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.CoreFn (ExprType(..), Ident(..), Literal(..), ModuleName(..), Qualified(..))
import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.FreeVars (localId)
import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.Syntax (BackendOperator(..), BackendOperator1(..), BackendOperator2(..), BackendOperatorNum(..), BackendSyntax(..), Level, Pair(..))

-- A pure function type alone does not permit short circuiting strict traverse:
-- callbacks can still throw, diverge or call foreign code. This deliberately
-- small proof accepts only total integer/boolean expressions and Maybe leaves.
-- Captured locals are already evaluated immutable values, never calls/getters.
totalIntegerMaybe :: Array Level -> TcoExpr -> Boolean
totalIntegerMaybe parameters expression = case unwrapTcoExpr expression of
  CtorSaturated (Qualified (Just (ModuleName "Data.Maybe")) _) _ _ (Ident "Nothing") [] -> true
  CtorSaturated (Qualified (Just (ModuleName "Data.Maybe")) _) _ _ (Ident "Just") [ Tuple _ value ] -> totalInt parameters value
  Branch branches otherwise -> all (\(Pair condition result) -> totalBoolean parameters condition && totalIntegerMaybe parameters result) branches
    && totalIntegerMaybe parameters otherwise
  _ -> false

totalInt :: Array Level -> TcoExpr -> Boolean
totalInt parameters expression = case unwrapTcoExpr expression of
  Local _ level -> Array.elem level parameters || getExprType expression == Int
  Lit (LitInt _) -> true
  PrimOp (Op1 OpIntNegate value) -> totalInt parameters value
  PrimOp (Op1 OpIntBitNot value) -> totalInt parameters value
  PrimOp (Op2 (OpIntNum operator) left right)
    | operator == OpAdd || operator == OpSubtract || operator == OpMultiply -> totalInt parameters left && totalInt parameters right
  _ -> false

totalBoolean :: Array Level -> TcoExpr -> Boolean
totalBoolean parameters expression = case unwrapTcoExpr expression of
  Local _ _ -> getExprType expression == Boolean
  Lit (LitBoolean _) -> true
  PrimOp (Op1 OpBooleanNot value) -> totalBoolean parameters value
  PrimOp (Op2 (OpIntOrd _) left right) -> totalInt parameters left && totalInt parameters right
  PrimOp (Op2 (OpBooleanOrd _) left right) -> totalBoolean parameters left && totalBoolean parameters right
  PrimOp (Op2 OpBooleanAnd left right) -> totalBoolean parameters left && totalBoolean parameters right
  PrimOp (Op2 OpBooleanOr left right) -> totalBoolean parameters left && totalBoolean parameters right
  _ -> false

emit :: TranslateExpr -> ExprContext -> Int -> Boolean -> Int -> Array TcoExpr -> Maybe ExprResult
emit translate context nextId indexed callbackOffset args = do
  guard (Array.length args == callbackOffset + 2)
  -- A recursive value can be represented by a delayed cell. Its local read is
  -- not the already evaluated scalar assumed by the totality proof.
  guard (Array.null context.recVars)
  callback <- Array.index args callbackOffset
  signature <- extractFuncType callback
  guard (signature.fArgs == (if indexed then [ Int, Int ] else [ Int ]))
  guard (signature.fRet == ADT "Data.Maybe.Maybe" [ "Data", "Maybe", "Maybe" ] [ Int ])
  case unwrapTcoExpr callback of
    Abs parameters result -> do
      let grouped = collectCurriedAbs parameters result
      let parametersArray = NEA.toArray grouped.args
      guard (Array.length parametersArray == Array.length signature.fArgs)
      guard (totalIntegerMaybe (map (\(Tuple _ level) -> level) parametersArray) grouped.body)
      pure (emitTotal translate context nextId callbackOffset args parametersArray grouped.body)
    _ -> Nothing

emitTotal :: TranslateExpr -> ExprContext -> Int -> Int -> Array TcoExpr -> Array (Tuple (Maybe Ident) Level) -> TcoExpr -> ExprResult
emitTotal translate context nextId callbackOffset args parameters result =
  let
    -- The admitted callback is an adjacent lambda, so constructing it has no
    -- evaluation. Other arguments still run in their original order and stage.
    captured = CallArguments.capture { prefix: "traverseTotal_arg_", markUsed: true }
      (\index currentId arg -> if index == callbackOffset then
        { stmts: StmtEmpty, expr: rawGo "true", exprType: TypeBool, nextId: currentId }
        else translate (childContext context Nothing) currentId arg) nextId args
    suffix = show captured.nextId
    valuesName = "traverseTotal_values_" <> suffix
    outputName = "traverseTotal_output_" <> suffix
    indexName = "traverseTotal_index_" <> suffix
    valueName = "traverseTotal_value_" <> suffix
    input = fromMaybe (rawGo "nil") (Array.index captured.exprs (callbackOffset + 1))
    inputType = fromMaybe TypeValue (Array.index captured.exprTypes (callbackOffset + 1))
    source = case inputType of
      TypeNativeArray inputElementType -> { expr: input, elementType: inputElementType }
      _ -> { expr: GoPrefixOp "*" (GoCall (rawGo "(*[]gopurs_runtime.Value)") [ GoSelector input "UnsafePtr" ]), elementType: TypeValue }
    parameterNames = map (\(Tuple name level) -> localId name level) parameters
    parameterTypes = map (const TypeInt64) parameters
    parameterValues = if Array.length parameters == 2 then
      [ GoCall (GoVar "int64") [ GoVar indexName ], integer (GoVar valueName) source.elementType ]
      else [ integer (GoVar valueName) source.elementType ]
    bindings = Array.zipWith GoAssign parameterNames parameterValues
    boundContext = (childContext context (Just Int))
      { bound = bindParameters (Array.zip parameterNames parameterTypes) context.bound }
    -- The canonical Array/Maybe instance and exact Int callback prove this
    -- result even when the surrounding polymorphic annotation is residual.
    maybeType = ADT "Data.Maybe.Maybe" [ "Data", "Maybe", "Maybe" ] [ Array Int ]
    nativeType = exprTypeToGoType context.metadata.sharedRecords context.metadata.pointerAdtPaths
      context.metadata.enumAdts context.metadata.elidedCtors context.modNameStr maybeType
    requested = case context.mbExpectedGoType of
      Nothing -> Just nativeType
      Just expected | expected == nativeType -> Just nativeType
      _ -> Nothing
    prepared name = AdtExprs.prepareSaturatedAs context.metadata context.modNameStr
      (Just (ModuleName "Data.Maybe")) name maybeType requested
    nativeOutput = (AdtExprs.saturatedFieldType (prepared "Just") 0).goType == TypeNativeArray TypeInt64
    elementType = if nativeOutput then TypeInt64 else TypeValue
    outputType = TypeNativeArray elementType
    constructor name fields =
      let
        built = AdtExprs.saturated context.codegenStateRef (prepared name)
          { exprs: fields, exprTypes: map (const (if nativeOutput then outputType else TypeValue)) fields }
      in if nativeOutput then built
        else { expr: boxGoExpr context.codegenStateRef context.modNameStr built.expr built.exprType, exprType: TypeValue }
    failure = constructor "Nothing" []
    success = constructor "Just" [ if nativeOutput then GoVar outputName
        else boxGoExpr context.codegenStateRef context.modNameStr (GoVar outputName) outputType ]
    loop = emitResult translate boundContext captured.nextId failure.expr elementType outputName indexName valuesName result
    body =
      [ GoAssign valuesName source.expr
      , GoAssign outputName (rawGo (goTypeToStr outputType <> "{}"))
      , GoForRange (indexName <> ", " <> valueName <> " := range " <> valuesName)
          ([ GoMutate "_" (GoVar indexName) ] <> bindings <> loop.stmts)
      ]
  in
    { stmts: captured.stmts
    , expr: GoCall (GoFuncLit [] body success.expr success.exprType) []
    , exprType: success.exprType
    , nextId: loop.nextId + 1
    }
  where
  integer expr from = coerceGoExpr context.codegenStateRef context.modNameStr expr from TypeInt64

-- Emit the callback's primitive branches directly into the loop. No per-element
-- closure/Maybe object is needed. On failure we may omit later callbacks only
-- because the complete callback body passed the totality proof above.
emitResult :: TranslateExpr -> ExprContext -> Int -> GoExpr -> GoType -> String -> String -> String -> TcoExpr -> { stmts :: Array GoExpr, nextId :: Int }
emitResult translate context nextId failure elementType outputName indexName valuesName expression = case unwrapTcoExpr expression of
  CtorSaturated _ _ _ (Ident "Nothing") [] -> { stmts: [ GoReturn failure ], nextId }
  CtorSaturated _ _ _ (Ident "Just") [ Tuple _ value ] ->
    let
      translated = translate context nextId value
      outputValue = coerceGoExpr context.codegenStateRef context.modNameStr translated.expr translated.exprType elementType
    in
      { stmts: flattenStmts translated.stmts <>
          [ GoIfElse (GoBinOp "==" (GoVar indexName) (GoInt 0))
              [ GoMutate outputName (GoCall (GoVar "make") [ rawGo (goTypeToStr (TypeNativeArray elementType)), GoCall (GoVar "len") [ GoVar valuesName ] ]) ] []
          , GoMutate (outputName <> "[" <> indexName <> "]") outputValue
          ]
      , nextId: translated.nextId
      }
  Branch branches otherwise ->
    foldr (\(Pair condition result) remaining ->
      let
        test = translate (childContext context (Just Boolean)) remaining.nextId condition
        yes = emitResult translate context test.nextId failure elementType outputName indexName valuesName result
      in
        { stmts: flattenStmts test.stmts <> [ GoIfElse test.expr yes.stmts remaining.stmts ], nextId: yes.nextId })
      (emitResult translate context nextId failure elementType outputName indexName valuesName otherwise) branches
  -- Unreachable: the complete tree is admitted before any code is emitted.
  _ -> { stmts: [], nextId }

module Gopurs.CallExprs
  ( application
  , uncurriedApplication
  , effectApplication
  ) where

import Prelude
import Data.Array as Array
import Data.Foldable (foldMap)
import Data.Map as Map
import Data.Maybe (Maybe(..), fromMaybe)
import Data.Newtype (unwrap)
import Data.String as String
import Data.String.Pattern (Pattern(..), Replacement(..))
import Data.Tuple (Tuple(..))
import Gopurs.ArrayIntrinsics as ArrayIntrinsics
import Gopurs.ArrayConcat as ArrayConcat
import Gopurs.ArrayIntrinsics.Callback as Callback
import Gopurs.ArrayTraverse as ArrayTraverse
import Gopurs.ArrayIndexedFold as ArrayIndexedFold
import Gopurs.ArrayEquality as ArrayEquality
import Gopurs.ScalarArrayFold as ScalarArrayFold
import Gopurs.ArrayRangeFold as ArrayRangeFold
import Gopurs.ArraySort as ArraySort
import Gopurs.ObjectTraverse as ObjectTraverse
import Gopurs.TailRecEffect as TailRecEffect
import Gopurs.PrivateSTRegions as PrivateSTRegions
import Gopurs.CallAnalysis (CallTarget, collectGoSpine, getGoSpineArgs, curriedTarget, qualifiedTarget)
import Gopurs.CallArguments (Arguments, applyBoxed)
import Gopurs.CallArguments as CallArguments
import Gopurs.CodegenState (FunctionInfo)
import Gopurs.ExprAnalysis (getExprType, unwrapTcoExpr)
import Gopurs.ExprContext (ExprContext, ExprResult, LoopTarget, TranslateExpr, StmtTree(..), childContext)
import Gopurs.GoAst (rawGo, GoExpr(..), GoType(..), goTypeToStr, sanitizeName)
import Gopurs.GoConversions (boxGoExpr, coerceGoExpr)
import Gopurs.GoFunctions (hasNativeRecordArgument, nativeCallbackCall)
import Gopurs.GoTypes (exprTypeToGoType)
import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.Codegen.Tco (TcoExpr)
import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.CoreFn (ExprType(..), Ident(..), Qualified(..))
import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.FreeVars (localId)
import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.Syntax (BackendSyntax(..))

application :: TranslateExpr -> ExprContext -> Int -> TcoExpr -> ExprResult
application translate context nextId expression =
  let
    Tuple fn spine = collectGoSpine expression
    args = getGoSpineArgs spine
  in
    -- Curried calls give a tail jump priority over intrinsic recognition.
    case tailTarget context fn of
      Just target -> tailCall translate context nextId expression args target
      Nothing -> case ObjectTraverse.emit translate context nextId (qualifiedTarget fn) args of
        Just result -> result
        Nothing -> case TailRecEffect.emit translate context nextId fn args of
          Just result -> result
          Nothing -> case PrivateSTRegions.emit translate context nextId fn args of
            Just result -> result
            Nothing -> regularApplication fn args
  where
  regularApplication fn args = case ArraySort.emit translate context nextId fn args of
    Just result -> result
    Nothing -> scalarApplication fn args

  scalarApplication fn args = case scalarFold translate context nextId fn args of
    Just result -> result
    Nothing -> arrayApplication fn args

  arrayApplication fn args = case ArrayEquality.emit translate context nextId fn args of
    Just result -> result
    Nothing -> case ArrayTraverse.emit translate context nextId fn args of
        Just result -> result
        Nothing ->
          let target = curriedTarget context.bound fn
          in case ArrayIntrinsics.recognize ArrayIntrinsics.Curried context.modNameStr target (Array.length args) of
            Just intrinsic ->
              ArrayIntrinsics.emitCurried translate context nextId fn args intrinsic
            Nothing -> case directFunction context target (Array.length args) of
              Just info ->
                let translated = directArguments translate context nextId info.fArgs args
                in nativeCall context (GoRef info.reference) info.fArgs info.fRet info.arity translated
              Nothing -> curriedCall translate context nextId fn args

scalarFold :: TranslateExpr -> ExprContext -> Int -> TcoExpr -> Array TcoExpr -> Maybe ExprResult
scalarFold translate context nextId fn args = case ArrayRangeFold.emit translate context nextId fn args of
  Just fused -> Just fused
  Nothing -> case ScalarArrayFold.emit translate context nextId fn args of
    Just folded -> Just folded
    Nothing -> ArrayIndexedFold.emit translate context nextId fn args

-- Only a published native predicate slot enables lambda lowering here. Other
-- calls retain their current translation. Capture every argument in source
-- order before entering the worker, including boxed callback factories.
directArguments :: TranslateExpr -> ExprContext -> Int -> Array GoType -> Array TcoExpr -> Arguments
directArguments translate context@{ codegenStateRef, modNameStr } nextId expected args =
  let predicateType = TypeFunc [ TypeInt64 ] TypeBool
  in if Array.elem predicateType expected then
    CallArguments.capture { prefix: "nativePredicate_arg_", markUsed: false }
      (\index argumentId arg ->
        let
          native = if Array.index expected index == Just predicateType && getExprType arg == Func [ Int ] Boolean then
            Callback.nativeLambda translate context argumentId 1 arg
            else Nothing
          result = case native of
            Just callback@{ expr: GoFuncLit params statements returned resultType } ->
              callback
                { expr = GoFuncLit params statements (coerceGoExpr codegenStateRef modNameStr returned resultType TypeBool) TypeBool
                , exprType = predicateType }
            _ -> translate (childContext context Nothing) argumentId arg
        in if Array.index expected index == Just predicateType then
          result { expr = coerceGoExpr codegenStateRef modNameStr result.expr result.exprType predicateType, exprType = predicateType }
          else result)
      nextId args
    -- A unary native consumer has no later argument evaluation across which
    -- array materialization could move. In particular concat's empty-side
    -- alias must not be copied early relative to another argument factory.
    else if expected == [ TypeNativeArray TypeInt64 ] && Array.length args == 1 then CallArguments.capture { prefix: "nativeArray_arg_", markUsed: false }
      (\index argumentId arg ->
        let native = if Array.index expected index == Just (TypeNativeArray TypeInt64) then
              ArrayConcat.nativeArgument translate context argumentId arg
              else Nothing
        in case native of
          Just result -> result
          Nothing -> translate ((childContext context Nothing)
            { mbExpectedGoType = Just (TypeNativeArray TypeInt64) }) argumentId arg)
      nextId args
    else CallArguments.translate translate context Nothing { stmts: StmtEmpty, nextId } args

-- A direct worker must be saturated; partial calls retain the boxed path.
directFunction :: ExprContext -> Maybe CallTarget -> Int -> Maybe FunctionInfo
directFunction { metadata, modNameStr, moduleFunctions } target count = do
  { mbMod, name } <- target
  let isLocal = map (String.replaceAll (Pattern ".") (Replacement "_") <<< unwrap) mbMod == Just modNameStr || mbMod == Nothing
  info <- if isLocal then Map.lookup name moduleFunctions
    else do
      mn <- mbMod
      Map.lookup (unwrap mn <> "." <> name) metadata.globalFunctions
  if count >= info.arity && info.arity >= 1 then Just info else Nothing

curriedCall :: TranslateExpr -> ExprContext -> Int -> TcoExpr -> Array TcoExpr -> ExprResult
curriedCall translate context@{ codegenStateRef, metadata, modNameStr } nextId fn args =
  let
    resFn = translate (childContext context Nothing) nextId fn
    argumentTypes = map (exprTypeToGoType metadata.sharedRecords metadata.pointerAdtPaths metadata.enumAdts metadata.elidedCtors modNameStr <<< getExprType) args
  in
    case resFn.exprType of
      TypeFunc fArgs fRet | Array.length args >= Array.length fArgs ->
        let translated = CallArguments.translate translate context Nothing { stmts: resFn.stmts, nextId: resFn.nextId } args
        in nativeCall context resFn.expr fArgs fRet (Array.length fArgs) translated
      _ | Array.length args <= 5 && hasNativeRecordArgument argumentTypes ->
        recordCallbackCall translate context resFn args
      _ ->
        let
          translated = CallArguments.translate translate context (Just Any) { stmts: resFn.stmts, nextId: resFn.nextId } args
          boxedArgs = CallArguments.boxRemaining context 0 translated
          expr = applyBoxed (boxGoExpr codegenStateRef modNameStr resFn.expr resFn.exprType) boxedArgs
        in
          { stmts: translated.stmts, expr, exprType: TypeValue, nextId: translated.nextId }

recordCallbackCall :: TranslateExpr -> ExprContext -> ExprResult -> Array TcoExpr -> ExprResult
recordCallbackCall translate context@{ codegenStateRef, modNameStr } fn args =
  let
    fnName = "__callback_fn_" <> show fn.nextId
    captured = CallArguments.capture { prefix: "__callback_arg_", markUsed: false }
      (\_ nextId arg ->
        let result = translate (childContext context Nothing) nextId arg
        -- A Go short declaration would default an untyped numeric literal to
        -- int/float64. Preserve its declared native ABI before capturing it.
        in result { expr = case result.exprType of
          TypeInt64 -> GoCall (GoVar "int64") [ result.expr ]
          TypeFloat64 -> GoCall (GoVar "float64") [ result.expr ]
          TypeUint32 -> GoCall (GoVar "uint32") [ result.expr ]
          _ -> result.expr
        })
      (fn.nextId + 1) args
    fnExpr = GoVar fnName
    fallback = applyBoxed fnExpr (CallArguments.boxRemaining context 0 captured)
    expr = if hasNativeRecordArgument captured.exprTypes then
      nativeCallbackCall fnExpr captured.exprTypes captured.exprs fallback
      else fallback
  in
    { stmts: fn.stmts
        <> StmtLeaf (GoAssign fnName (boxGoExpr codegenStateRef modNameStr fn.expr fn.exprType))
        <> captured.stmts
    , expr
    , exprType: TypeValue
    , nextId: captured.nextId
    }

-- Coerce the native prefix and apply any surplus arguments to its boxed
-- result. Boxing surplus arguments stays before prefix coercion, as before.
nativeCall :: ExprContext -> GoExpr -> Array GoType -> GoType -> Int -> Arguments -> ExprResult
nativeCall context@{ codegenStateRef, modNameStr } fn expected ret arity args =
  let
    remaining = CallArguments.boxRemaining context arity args
    callArgs = CallArguments.coercePrefix context arity expected args
    call = GoCall fn callArgs
    expr = if Array.null remaining then call else applyBoxed (boxGoExpr codegenStateRef modNameStr call ret) remaining
    exprType = if Array.null remaining then ret else TypeValue
  in
    { stmts: args.stmts, expr, exprType, nextId: args.nextId }

uncurriedApplication :: TranslateExpr -> ExprContext -> Int -> TcoExpr -> TcoExpr -> Array TcoExpr -> ExprResult
uncurriedApplication translate context nextId expression fn args =
  -- Uncurried calls recognize intrinsics before considering a tail jump.
  case ArraySort.emit translate context nextId fn args of
    Just result -> result
    Nothing -> uncurriedScalarApplication translate context nextId expression fn args

uncurriedScalarApplication :: TranslateExpr -> ExprContext -> Int -> TcoExpr -> TcoExpr -> Array TcoExpr -> ExprResult
uncurriedScalarApplication translate context nextId expression fn args =
  case scalarFold translate context nextId fn args of
    Just result -> result
    Nothing -> uncurriedArrayApplication translate context nextId expression fn args

uncurriedArrayApplication :: TranslateExpr -> ExprContext -> Int -> TcoExpr -> TcoExpr -> Array TcoExpr -> ExprResult
uncurriedArrayApplication translate context nextId expression fn args =
  case ArrayEquality.emit translate context nextId fn args of
    Just result -> result
    Nothing -> case ArrayIntrinsics.safeIndex translate context nextId (qualifiedTarget fn) args of
      Just result -> result
      Nothing -> case ArrayIntrinsics.recognize ArrayIntrinsics.Uncurried context.modNameStr (qualifiedTarget fn) (Array.length args) of
        Just intrinsic ->
          ArrayIntrinsics.emitUncurried translate context nextId args intrinsic
        Nothing ->
          let
            Tuple flatFn spine = collectGoSpine expression
            flatArgs = getGoSpineArgs spine
          in
            case tailTarget context flatFn of
              Just target -> tailCall translate context nextId expression flatArgs target
              Nothing -> uncurriedCall translate context 10 nextId fn args

effectApplication :: TranslateExpr -> ExprContext -> Int -> TcoExpr -> Array TcoExpr -> ExprResult
effectApplication translate context = uncurriedCall translate context 5

-- Effect applications and ordinary uncurried applications differ only in
-- the largest runtime wrapper they select. Both box their final result.
uncurriedCall :: TranslateExpr -> ExprContext -> Int -> Int -> TcoExpr -> Array TcoExpr -> ExprResult
uncurriedCall translate context@{ codegenStateRef, modNameStr } maxArity nextId fn args =
  let
    resFn = translate (childContext context Nothing) nextId fn
    translated = CallArguments.translate translate context Nothing { stmts: resFn.stmts, nextId: resFn.nextId } args
    len = Array.length args
    goFuncName = if len >= 2 && len <= maxArity then "UncurriedApp" <> show len else "UncurriedApp"
    expr = case resFn.exprType of
      TypeFunc fArgs fRet | Array.length fArgs == len ->
        let callArgs = CallArguments.coercePrefix context len fArgs translated
        in boxGoExpr codegenStateRef modNameStr (GoCall resFn.expr callArgs) fRet
      _ ->
        let boxedArgs = CallArguments.boxRemaining context 0 translated
        in GoCall (GoSelector (GoVar "gopurs_runtime") goFuncName)
          (Array.cons (boxGoExpr codegenStateRef modNameStr resFn.expr resFn.exprType) boxedArgs)
  in
    { stmts: translated.stmts, expr, exprType: TypeValue, nextId: translated.nextId }

tailTarget :: ExprContext -> TcoExpr -> Maybe LoopTarget
tailTarget { bound, loopCtx, options: { isTail } } fn =
  if isTail then case unwrapTcoExpr fn of
    Local mbIdent lvl ->
      let binding = fromMaybe { name: localId mbIdent lvl, goType: TypeValue } (Map.lookup (localId mbIdent lvl) bound)
      in Array.find (\target -> target.ident == binding.name) loopCtx
    Var (Qualified _ (Ident name)) -> Array.find (\target -> target.ident == sanitizeName name) loopCtx
    _ -> Nothing
  else Nothing

tailCall :: TranslateExpr -> ExprContext -> Int -> TcoExpr -> Array TcoExpr -> LoopTarget -> ExprResult
tailCall translate context@{ metadata, codegenStateRef, modNameStr, mbExpectedExprType } nextId expression args target =
  let
    -- Translate all operands outside tail position before updating the loop
    -- slots. Their references use the current iteration's immutable parameters
    -- (GoFunctions.iterationBindings), not slots changed by earlier assignments.
    translated = CallArguments.translate translate context Nothing { stmts: StmtEmpty, nextId } args
    assigns = Array.mapWithIndex
      (\index param -> GoMutate param (coerceGoExpr codegenStateRef modNameStr
        (fromMaybe (rawGo "nil") (Array.index translated.exprs index))
        (fromMaybe TypeValue (Array.index translated.exprTypes index))
        (fromMaybe TypeValue (Array.index target.goTypes index))))
      target.loopParams
    expectedGoType = exprTypeToGoType metadata.sharedRecords metadata.pointerAdtPaths metadata.enumAdts metadata.elidedCtors modNameStr
      (case getExprType expression of
        Any -> fromMaybe Any mbExpectedExprType
        ty -> ty)
  in
    { stmts: translated.stmts <> foldMap StmtLeaf assigns <> StmtLeaf (GoContinue target.ident)
    , expr: rawGo ("func() " <> goTypeToStr expectedGoType <> " { panic(\"unreachable\") }()")
    , exprType: expectedGoType
    , nextId: translated.nextId
    }
