module Gopurs.ClosedIndexedFolds (optimize) where

import Prelude

import Control.Alternative (guard)
import Data.Array as Array
import Data.Array.NonEmpty as NEA
import Data.Foldable (all, foldM)
import Data.Map as Map
import Data.Maybe (Maybe(..), fromMaybe, isJust)
import Data.Tuple (Tuple(..))
import Gopurs.ArrayIndexedFold (integerCallback, readOnlyScalar)
import Gopurs.CallAnalysis (collectCurriedAbs)
import Gopurs.ExprAnalysis (unwrapTcoExpr)
import Gopurs.ImmediateApplications.Scope (maximumLevel)
import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.Codegen.Tco as Tco
import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.Convert (BackendModule)
import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.CoreFn (ExprType(Any, Array, Func, Int, ADT, TypeVar), Ident(..), Literal(..), ModuleName(..), Qualified(..))
import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.Semantics (NeutralExpr(..))
import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.Syntax (BackendSyntax(..), Level(..))

-- A closed primitive callback and a literal seed have no observable capture
-- work. Expose the remaining array parameter before native worker signatures
-- are computed, using the existing cross-module worker/cache protocol.
optimize :: BackendModule -> BackendModule
optimize mod = mod { bindings = map (\group -> if group.recursive then group else
  group { bindings = map (\(Tuple name value) -> Tuple name (fromMaybe value (expand value))) group.bindings }) mod.bindings }

expand :: NeutralExpr -> Maybe NeutralExpr
expand original = do
  guard (compatible (Func [ Array Int ] Int) original)
  call <- case strip original of
    App function arguments -> case NEA.toArray arguments of
      [ callback, seed ] -> Just { function, callback, seed }
      _ -> Nothing
    _ -> Nothing
  guard (case strip call.function of
    Var (Qualified (Just (ModuleName "Data.FoldableWithIndex")) (Ident "foldlWithIndexImpl")) -> true
    _ -> false)
  guard (compatible Int call.seed)
  guard (case strip call.seed of
    Lit (LitInt _) -> true
    _ -> false)
  guard (closed [] call.callback)
  let callback = Tco.analyze [] call.callback
  guard (integerCallback callback)
  case unwrapTcoExpr callback of
    Abs parameters body -> do
      let grouped = collectCurriedAbs parameters body
      guard (NEA.length grouped.args == 3)
      guard (readOnlyScalar (map (\(Tuple _ level) -> level) (NEA.toArray grouped.args)) grouped.body)
      let
        level = Level (maximumLevel original + 1)
        name = Just (Ident "__gopurs_indexed_input")
        input = NeutralExpr (Typed (Array Int) (NeutralExpr (Local name level)))
        applied = NeutralExpr (Typed Int (NeutralExpr (App call.function (NEA.cons' call.callback [ call.seed, input ]))))
      pure (NeutralExpr (Typed (Func [ Array Int ] Int) (NeutralExpr (Abs (NEA.singleton (Tuple name level)) applied))))
    _ -> Nothing

-- PBO retains both the instantiated annotation and inner generic annotations.
-- Check that each has a consistent specialization, including Prim.Array's
-- equivalent TAST spelling; never erase a concrete contradiction.
compatible :: ExprType -> NeutralExpr -> Boolean
compatible expected (NeutralExpr syntax) = case syntax of
  Typed actual value -> isJust (refine expected actual Map.empty) && compatible expected value
  TypeApp value _ -> compatible expected value
  _ -> true

refine :: ExprType -> ExprType -> Map.Map String ExprType -> Maybe (Map.Map String ExprType)
refine expected actual variables = case actual, expected of
  Any, _ -> Just variables
  TypeVar name, _ -> case Map.lookup name variables of
    Just previous | previous /= expected -> Nothing
    _ -> Just (Map.insert name expected variables)
  Array element, Array wanted -> refine wanted element variables
  ADT "Prim.Array" [ "Prim", "Array" ] [ element ], Array wanted -> refine wanted element variables
  Func arguments result, Func wantedArguments wantedResult -> do
    guard (Array.length arguments == Array.length wantedArguments)
    foldM (\known (Tuple wanted supplied) -> refine wanted supplied known) variables
      (Array.snoc (Array.zip wantedArguments arguments) (Tuple wantedResult result))
  _, _ | actual == expected -> Just variables
  _, _ -> Nothing

closed :: Array Level -> NeutralExpr -> Boolean
closed locals expression = case strip expression of
  Local _ level -> Array.elem level locals
  Var _ -> false
  Abs parameters body -> closed (locals <> map (\(Tuple _ level) -> level) (NEA.toArray parameters)) body
  Let _ level value body -> closed locals value && closed (Array.snoc locals level) body
  LetRec _ _ _ -> false
  syntax -> all (closed locals) syntax

strip :: NeutralExpr -> BackendSyntax NeutralExpr
strip (NeutralExpr syntax) = case syntax of
  Typed _ expression -> strip expression
  TypeApp expression _ -> strip expression
  _ -> syntax

translate :: CodegenMetadata -> BackendModule -> String
translate metadata inputMod = (translateWithFunctions metadata inputMod).code

translateWithFunctions :: CodegenMetadata -> BackendModule -> { code :: String, functions :: ModuleFunctions, file :: GoFile }
translateWithFunctions metadata inputMod = translatePreparedWithFunctions metadata (prepareModule metadata inputMod)

type PreparedModule =
  { module :: BackendModule
  , declarations :: Array GoDecl
  , functions :: ModuleFunctions
  , workers :: Map.Map String (Maybe FunctionInfo)
  }

-- These transformations consume source metadata, not imported worker signatures
-- or module-local FFI signatures. Prepare once, before computing the emission
-- key, so references introduced by a transformation belong to its proof too.
prepareModule :: CodegenMetadata -> BackendModule -> PreparedModule
prepareModule metadata inputMod =
  let
    projected = ListFusion.optimize (RegexMatchProjection.optimize metadata (ClosedIndexedFolds.optimize inputMod))
    progressions = ListProgressionFold.prepare projected
    constants = ClosedScalar.optimize (RefLoopRegions.optimize progressions.module)
    constructors = ConstructorFold.optimize constants
    schemas = specializeDecoderSchemas metadata (borrowReadOnlyObjects metadata (cacheClosedDictionaries metadata (optimizeImmediateApplications (optimizeFunctionProducers (optimizeThunkProducers constructors)))))
    owned = Ownership.prepare metadata schemas.module
  in
    { module: owned.module
    , declarations: owned.declarations <> schemas.declarations <> progressions.declarations
    , functions: Map.union owned.functions progressions.functions
    , workers: workerInputs metadata.globalFunctions owned.module
    }

-- Imported ordinary and immediate-effect workers use qualified Var targets;
-- local targets use the module's
-- own signatures. Include every such Var, even if it is not called, and record
-- absences in the exact batch snapshot. TCO preserves these qualifications.
workerInputs :: ModuleFunctions -> BackendModule -> Map.Map String (Maybe FunctionInfo)
workerInputs available = foldWorkerReferences
  (\owner name acc -> foldl
    (\entries ident -> let key = unwrap owner <> "." <> ident in Map.insert key (Map.lookup key available) entries)
    acc [ name, ImmediateEffects.key name ])
  Map.empty

-- The emitter can resolve immutable owner contributions without decoding every
-- earlier module's signatures. Keep the exact qualified-Var inventory shared
-- with workerInputs, including FFI targets and references introduced by passes.
workerOwners :: BackendModule -> Set.Set String
workerOwners = foldWorkerReferences (\owner _ -> Set.insert (unwrap owner)) Set.empty

-- Conservative requests are collected explicitly by the emitter. They do not
-- need to be complete: LookupTable checks coverage on every actual lookup.
globalTypeDemands :: BackendModule -> Set.Set String
globalTypeDemands mod = foldl
  (\acc group -> foldl (\entries (Tuple _ value) -> visit entries value) acc group.bindings)
  (Set.fromFoldable
    [ "Data.Argonaut.Decode.Internal.Record.schemaDecoderABI1"
    , "Data.Argonaut.Decode.Parser.textDecoderABI1"
    , "Data.Argonaut.Decode.Internal.Record.borrowObject"
    , RegexMatchProjection.helperName
    , RegexMatchProjection.adapterName
    ]) mod.bindings
  where
  visit acc (NeutralExpr syntax) = case syntax of
    Var (Qualified (Just owner) (Ident name)) -> Set.insert (unwrap owner <> "." <> name) acc
    _ -> foldl visit acc syntax

foldWorkerReferences :: forall a. (CoreFn.ModuleName -> String -> a -> a) -> a -> BackendModule -> a
foldWorkerReferences insert initial mod = foldl
  (\acc group -> foldl (\entries (Tuple _ value) -> visit entries value) acc group.bindings)
  initial
  mod.bindings
  where
  visit acc (NeutralExpr syntax) = case syntax of
    Var (Qualified (Just owner) (Ident name)) | owner /= mod.name ->
      insert owner name acc
    _ -> foldl visit acc syntax

-- Source metadata must be the same as at preparation. Output supplies the
-- freshly parsed local FFI signatures here. Restrict imported signatures to
-- exactly the snapshot covered by the emission key, including on fresh builds.
translatePreparedWithFunctions :: CodegenMetadata -> PreparedModule -> { code :: String, functions :: ModuleFunctions, file :: GoFile }
translatePreparedWithFunctions sourceMetadata prepared =
  let
    metadata = sourceMetadata { globalFunctions = Map.mapMaybe identity prepared.workers }
    mod = prepared.module
    modNameStrOrig = unwrap mod.name
    modNameStr = String.replaceAll (Pattern ".") (Replacement "_") modNameStrOrig

    codegenStateRef :: Ref CodegenState
    codegenStateRef = unsafePerformEffect $
      Ref.new { declarations: ModuleDeclarations.constructors metadata modNameStr mod, globalId: 0, reboxPairs: Set.empty }

    preparedBindings = ModuleBindings.prepare metadata modNameStr mod
    -- The module's FFI functions are keyed by raw identifier; local functions
    -- take precedence when names collide.
    -- Reserved immediate-effect signatures must never become ordinary local
    -- calls after sanitizing their otherwise impossible PureScript names.
    ffiLocalFunctions = Map.fromFoldable $ Array.mapMaybe
      (\(Tuple (Ident name) _) -> map (Tuple (sanitizeName name)) (Map.lookup name metadata.ffiFunctions))
      (Map.toUnfoldable mod.foreign)
    moduleFunctions = Map.union (Map.union prepared.functions preparedBindings.functions) ffiLocalFunctions
    normalFunctions = Map.fromFoldable $ Array.concatMap
      (\group -> Array.mapMaybe
        (\(Tuple (Ident name) _) -> do
          info <- Map.lookup (sanitizeName name) moduleFunctions
          guard (info.arity >= 1 && info.arity <= 10)
          pure (Tuple (unwrap mod.name <> "." <> name) info))
        group.bindings)
      preparedBindings.bindings
    -- Export FFI functions as `<Module>.<ident>` for callers in other modules.
    ffiGlobalFunctions = Map.fromFoldable $ map
      (\(Tuple name info) -> Tuple (unwrap mod.name <> "." <> name) info)
      (Map.toUnfoldable metadata.ffiFunctions :: Array (Tuple String FunctionInfo))

    Tuple allDeclsAst helpers = unsafePerformEffect do
      let
        d = ModuleBindings.declarations translateExpr metadata codegenStateRef modNameStr moduleFunctions preparedBindings.bindings
      h <- Ref.read codegenStateRef
      pure (Tuple d h)

    foreignGetters = map
      (\(Tuple (Ident name) _) -> GoForeignGetter
        { name: generated modNameStr ("Get_" <> modNameStr <> "_" <> sanitizeName name)
        , value: foreignSymbol modNameStr ("_Gopurs_" <> modNameStr <> "_" <> capitalize (sanitizeName name))
        })
      (Map.toUnfoldable mod.foreign)
    declarationGroups = map (map RecordReadGroups.declaration)
      [ allDeclsAst <> prepared.declarations
      , helpers.declarations <> unsafePerformEffect (generateReboxFunctions metadata codegenStateRef modNameStr)
      , foreignGetters
      ]
    goFile = { packageName: "purescript", imports: collectImports declarationGroups, declarationGroups }

  in
    { code: printGoFile goFile
    , functions: Map.union normalFunctions ffiGlobalFunctions
    , file: goFile
    }

translateExpr :: TranslateExpr
translateExpr context@{ metadata, codegenStateRef, modNameStr, bound, options: { inEffectBlock }, mbExpectedExprType } nextId tcoExpr@(TcoExpr _ expr) =
  let
    child = childContext context Nothing
    isEff = isEffectNode tcoExpr
  in
    if isEff && not inEffectBlock then
      EffectExprs.wrap translateExpr context nextId tcoExpr
    else
      case expr of
        Typed type_ a ->
          TypedExprs.annotated translateExpr context nextId type_ a
        Var (Qualified mbMn (Ident i)) ->
          let
            safeName = sanitizeName i
            vType = case mbMn of
              Just mn ->
                let
                  modStr = unwrap mn
                in
                  case LookupTable.lookup (modStr <> "." <> i) metadata.globalTypes of
                    Just ty -> exprTypeToGoType metadata.sharedRecords metadata.pointerAdtPaths metadata.enumAdts metadata.elidedCtors modNameStr ty
                    Nothing -> TypeValue
              Nothing -> TypeValue
          in
            case mbMn of
              Just mn ->
                let
                  modStr = unwrap mn
                  modPkg = String.replaceAll (Pattern ".") (Replacement "_") modStr
                  rawCall = GoCall (GoRef (SymbolReference (generated modPkg ("Get_" <> modPkg <> "_" <> safeName)))) []
                in
                  { stmts: StmtEmpty, expr: coerceGoExpr codegenStateRef modNameStr rawCall TypeValue vType, exprType: vType, nextId }
              Nothing ->
                let
                  rawCall = GoCall (GoRef (SymbolReference (generated modNameStr ("Get_" <> modNameStr <> "_" <> safeName)))) []
                in
                  { stmts: StmtEmpty, expr: coerceGoExpr codegenStateRef modNameStr rawCall TypeValue vType, exprType: vType, nextId }

        Local mbIdent lvl ->
          let
            v = fromMaybe { name: localId mbIdent lvl, goType: TypeValue } (Map.lookup (localId mbIdent lvl) bound)
          in
            { stmts: StmtEmpty, expr: GoVar v.name, exprType: v.goType, nextId }

        Lit value
          | Just result <- PrimitiveExprs.literal value ->
              { stmts: StmtEmpty, expr: result.expr, exprType: result.exprType, nextId }

        Lit (LitArray xs) ->
          LiteralExprs.array translateExpr context nextId xs

        Lit (LitRecord props) ->
          LiteralExprs.record translateExpr context nextId (getExprType tcoExpr) props

        expr_
          | ( case expr_ of
                App _ _ -> true
                Syn.TypeApp _ _ -> true
                _ -> false
            ) ->
              CallExprs.application translateExpr context nextId tcoExpr

        Abs args body ->
          FunctionExprs.abstraction translateExpr context nextId tcoExpr args body

        UncurriedApp fn args ->
          CallExprs.uncurriedApplication translateExpr context nextId tcoExpr fn args

        UncurriedAbs args body ->
          FunctionExprs.uncurriedAbstraction translateExpr context nextId tcoExpr args body

        UncurriedEffectApp fn args ->
          CallExprs.effectApplication translateExpr context nextId fn args

        UncurriedEffectAbs args body ->
          FunctionExprs.effectAbstraction translateExpr context nextId tcoExpr args body

        EffectBind mbIdent lvl binding body ->
          EffectExprs.bindEffect translateExpr context nextId mbIdent lvl binding body

        EffectPure binding ->
          EffectExprs.pureValue translateExpr context nextId binding

        EffectDefer binding ->
          EffectExprs.defer translateExpr context nextId binding

        Let mbIdent lvl binding body ->
          BindingExprs.nonRecursive translateExpr context nextId mbIdent lvl binding body

        LetRec lvl bindings body ->
          BindingExprs.recursive translateExpr context nextId tcoExpr lvl bindings body

        Accessor obj accessor ->
          let
            resObj = translateExpr child nextId obj
          in
            case accessor of
              GetProp prop ->
                let
                  result = RecordExprs.getProp metadata codegenStateRef modNameStr prop { expr: resObj.expr, exprType: resObj.exprType }
                in
                  { stmts: resObj.stmts, expr: result.expr, exprType: result.exprType, nextId: resObj.nextId }
              GetIndex idx -> { stmts: resObj.stmts, expr: GoCall (GoSelector (GoVar "gopurs_runtime") "ArrayAccess") [ (boxGoExpr codegenStateRef modNameStr resObj.expr resObj.exprType), GoInt idx ], exprType: TypeValue, nextId: resObj.nextId }
              GetCtorField (Qualified mbMod _) _ _ (Ident ctorName) _ idx ->
                let
                  result = AdtExprs.getField metadata codegenStateRef modNameStr
                    { moduleName: mbMod, ctorName, index: idx }
                    { expr: resObj.expr, exprType: resObj.exprType, sourceType: getExprType obj }
                in
                  { stmts: resObj.stmts, expr: result.expr, exprType: result.exprType, nextId: resObj.nextId }

        Update obj props ->
          let
            resObj = translateExpr child nextId obj
            accProps = foldl
              ( \acc (Prop key val) ->
                  let
                    resVal = translateExpr child acc.nextId val
                  in
                    { stmts: acc.stmts <> resVal.stmts, exprs: Array.snoc acc.exprs { key, expr: resVal.expr, goType: resVal.exprType }, exprType: TypeValue, nextId: resVal.nextId }
              )
              { stmts: StmtEmpty, exprs: [], exprType: TypeValue, nextId: resObj.nextId }
              props
            resultType = map (exprTypeToGoType metadata.sharedRecords metadata.pointerAdtPaths metadata.enumAdts metadata.elidedCtors modNameStr) mbExpectedExprType
            result = RecordExprs.update codegenStateRef modNameStr resultType { expr: resObj.expr, exprType: resObj.exprType } accProps.exprs
          in
            { stmts: resObj.stmts <> accProps.stmts, expr: result.expr, exprType: result.exprType, nextId: accProps.nextId }

        CtorDef _ _ (Ident name) fields ->
          ConstructorExprs.definition context nextId tcoExpr name fields

        CtorSaturated (Qualified mbMod _) _ _ (Ident name) props ->
          ConstructorExprs.saturated translateExpr context nextId tcoExpr mbMod name props

        Fail msg ->
          ControlExprs.failure context nextId tcoExpr msg

        Branch branches def ->
          ControlExprs.branch translateExpr context nextId branches def

        PrimOp (Op1 op1 e)
          | Just emit <- PrimitiveExprs.unary codegenStateRef modNameStr op1 ->
              let
                resE = translateExpr child nextId e
                result = emit { expr: resE.expr, exprType: resE.exprType }
              in
                { stmts: resE.stmts, expr: result.expr, exprType: result.exprType, nextId: resE.nextId }

        PrimOp (Op1 (OpIsTag (Qualified mbMod (Ident tag))) e) ->
          let
            -- A pointer ADT's tag is independent of its type arguments. Keep
            -- the operand's representation: coercing a boxed List here would
            -- copy its entire tail merely to distinguish Nil from Cons.
            translateOperand expected operand@(TcoExpr _ syntax) =
              case syntax of
                Typed type_ inner
                  | TypeStructPointer _ <- exprTypeToGoType metadata.sharedRecords metadata.pointerAdtPaths metadata.enumAdts metadata.elidedCtors modNameStr type_ ->
                      translateOperand (Just type_) inner
                _ ->
                  translateExpr (child { mbExpectedExprType = expected }) nextId operand
            resE = translateOperand Nothing e
          in
            AdtExprs.isTag metadata codegenStateRef modNameStr mbMod tag resE

        PrimOp (Op1 OpArrayLength e) ->
          let
            resE = translateExpr child nextId e
          in
            case resE.exprType of
              TypeNativeArray _ -> { stmts: resE.stmts, expr: GoCall (GoSelector (GoVar "gopurs_runtime") "Int") [ GoCall (GoVar "int64") [ GoCall (GoVar "len") [ resE.expr ] ] ], exprType: TypeValue, nextId: resE.nextId }
              _ -> { stmts: resE.stmts, expr: GoCall (GoSelector (GoVar "gopurs_runtime") "Int") [ GoCall (GoVar "int64") [ GoCall (GoSelector (GoVar "gopurs_runtime") "ArrayLength") [ boxGoExpr codegenStateRef modNameStr resE.expr resE.exprType ] ] ], exprType: TypeValue, nextId: resE.nextId }

        PrimOp (Op2 OpBooleanAnd e1 e2) ->
          ControlExprs.booleanAnd translateExpr context nextId e1 e2

        PrimOp (Op2 OpBooleanOr e1 e2) ->
          ControlExprs.booleanOr translateExpr context nextId e1 e2

        PrimOp (Op2 OpArrayIndex e1 e2) ->
          ArrayIntrinsics.unsafeIndex translateExpr context nextId e1 e2

        PrimOp (Op2 op2 e1 e2)
          | Just result <- PrimitiveExprs.stringLengthComparison translateExpr context nextId op2 e1 e2 ->
              result

        PrimOp (Op2 op2 e1 e2)
          | Just result <- PrimitiveExprs.boundedIntProduct translateExpr context nextId op2 e1 e2 ->
              result

        PrimOp (Op2 op2 e1 e2)
          | Just emit <- PrimitiveExprs.binary codegenStateRef modNameStr op2 ->
              let
                res1 = translateExpr child nextId e1
                res2 = translateExpr child res1.nextId e2
                result = emit { expr: res1.expr, exprType: res1.exprType } { expr: res2.expr, exprType: res2.exprType }
              in
                { stmts: res1.stmts <> res2.stmts, expr: result.expr, exprType: result.exprType, nextId: res2.nextId }

        PrimEffect eff ->
          EffectExprs.primitive translateExpr context nextId eff

        _ -> { stmts: StmtEmpty, expr: GoVar "gopurs_runtime.Value{}", exprType: TypeValue, nextId }

module Gopurs.ModuleWorkers (declaration) where

import Prelude
import Data.Array as Array
import Data.Map as Map
import Data.Maybe (Maybe(..))
import Data.Tuple (Tuple(..), fst, snd)
import Effect.Ref as Ref
import Effect.Unsafe (unsafePerformEffect)
import Gopurs.ExprAnalysis (extractExprFuncType, functionResultAfter, getExprType)
import Gopurs.ExprContext (ExprContext, TranslateExpr, bindParameters, flattenStmts)
import Gopurs.ArrayIndexedFold as ArrayIndexedFold
import Gopurs.CallAnalysis (collectGoSpine, getGoSpineArgs)
import Gopurs.GoAst (GoDecl(..), GoExpr(..), GoType(..))
import Gopurs.GoSymbol (GoReference(..), generated)
import Gopurs.GoConversions (boxGoExpr, coerceGoExpr)
import Gopurs.GoFunctions (Parameters, curriedFunction, iterationBindings, loopParameters, namedParameters)
import Gopurs.Int32Loops as Int32Loops
import Gopurs.AffineLoops as AffineLoops
import Gopurs.ArraySnoc as ArraySnoc
import Gopurs.ListFilter as ListFilter
import Gopurs.TailAddLoops as TailAddLoops
import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.Codegen.Tco (TcoExpr)

type Worker =
  { ident :: String
  , args :: Array String
  , body :: TcoExpr
  , val :: TcoExpr
  }

-- Use precisely the ABI published by ModuleBindings, including native record
-- projections. A self-recursive singleton gets a loop; peers in larger groups
-- remain ordinary calls. Module bodies begin with no captured local bindings.
declaration :: TranslateExpr -> ExprContext -> Boolean -> Worker -> GoDecl
declaration translate context@{ codegenStateRef, modNameStr, moduleFunctions } isSelfRecursive fn =
  let
    info = Map.lookup fn.ident moduleFunctions
    params = namedParameters fn.args (case info of
      Just signature -> signature.fArgs
      Nothing -> [])
    expectedBodyType = map (functionResultAfter (Array.length fn.args)) (extractExprFuncType (getExprType fn.val))
    loop = if isSelfRecursive then
      [ { ident: fn.ident, loopParams: map fst (loopParameters params), goTypes: map snd params } ]
      else []
    workerContext = context
      { depth = 0
      , bound = bindParameters params Map.empty
      , tcoIdent = Just fn.ident
      , loopCtx = loop
      , options = { isTail: isSelfRecursive, inEffectBlock: false }
      , mbExpectedExprType = expectedBodyType
      , mbExpectedGoType = if Array.null fn.args || resultType == TypeValue then Nothing else Just resultType
      }
    resultType = case info of
      Just signature | Array.length fn.args < Array.length signature.fArgs -> TypeValue
      Just signature -> signature.fRet
      Nothing -> TypeValue
    tailAdd = if isSelfRecursive then
      TailAddLoops.worker translate workerContext fn.ident params resultType fn.body
      else Nothing
    body boxed = case tailAdd of
      Just loopBody -> loopBody
      Nothing ->
        let
          native = case ListFilter.worker context.metadata params resultType fn.val of
            Just filtered -> Just filtered
            Nothing -> ArraySnoc.worker modNameStr fn.ident params resultType fn.body
          result = case native of
            Just lowered -> lowered
            Nothing -> translate workerContext 0 fn.body
          returning = if boxed then boxGoExpr codegenStateRef modNameStr result.expr result.exprType
            else coerceGoExpr codegenStateRef modNameStr result.expr result.exprType resultType
          statements = flattenStmts result.stmts <> [ GoReturn returning ]
        in if isSelfRecursive then
          AffineLoops.wrap translate workerContext (AffineLoops.globalTarget modNameStr fn.ident) params resultType fn.body
            (Int32Loops.loop fn.ident params resultType statements)
          else GoBlock (iterationBindings params <> statements)
    value = if Array.null fn.args then
      -- A zero-argument abstraction still defers its whole body until called.
      curriedFunction [ Tuple "_" TypeValue ] TypeValue
        (body true)
      else
        let
          worker = GoFunctionDecl
            { name: generated modNameStr ("Call_" <> modNameStr <> "_" <> fn.ident)
            , params: loopParameters params
            , result: resultType
            , body: body false
            }
        in
          unsafePerformEffect do
            Ref.modify_ (\state -> state { declarations = Array.snoc state.declarations worker }) codegenStateRef
            pure (case indexedWrapper translate context params fn.body of
              Just wrapper -> wrapper
              Nothing -> boxedWrapper context fn.ident params resultType)
  in
    GoCachedValue { identifier: generated modNameStr (modNameStr <> "_" <> fn.ident), expression: value, goType: TypeValue }

-- A scalar indexed fold can read either representation directly. Keep the
-- public Value wrapper on its original Value buffer instead of first copying
-- it into the native worker's array. Admission is shared with the fold emitter.
indexedWrapper :: TranslateExpr -> ExprContext -> Parameters -> TcoExpr -> Maybe GoExpr
indexedWrapper translate context params body = case params of
  [ Tuple name (TypeNativeArray TypeInt64) ] -> do
    let
      boxedContext = context { bound = bindParameters [ Tuple name TypeValue ] Map.empty }
      Tuple function spine = collectGoSpine body
    result <- ArrayIndexedFold.emit translate boxedContext 0 function (getGoSpineArgs spine)
    pure (GoCall (GoVar "gopurs_runtime.Func")
      [ GoFuncLit [ Tuple name TypeValue ] (flattenStmts result.stmts)
          (boxGoExpr context.codegenStateRef context.modNameStr result.expr result.exprType) TypeValue ])
  _ -> Nothing

-- Module wrappers group up to ten arguments; larger arities keep unary layers.
-- LocalWorkers and anonymous closures retain their own grouping policies.
boxedWrapper :: ExprContext -> String -> Parameters -> GoType -> GoExpr
boxedWrapper { codegenStateRef, modNameStr } name params resultType =
  let
    wrapperParams = map (\(Tuple param _) -> param <> "_box") params
    call = GoCall (GoRef (SymbolReference (generated modNameStr ("Call_" <> modNameStr <> "_" <> name))))
      (map (\(Tuple param ty) -> coerceGoExpr codegenStateRef modNameStr (GoVar (param <> "_box")) TypeValue ty) params)
    boxed = boxGoExpr codegenStateRef modNameStr call resultType
    arity = Array.length params
    wrapperName = if arity == 1 then "gopurs_runtime.Func" else "gopurs_runtime.Func" <> show arity
  in
    if arity <= 10 then
      GoCall (GoVar wrapperName) [ GoFuncLit (map (\param -> Tuple param TypeValue) wrapperParams) [] boxed TypeValue ]
    else Array.foldr
      (\param inner -> GoCall (GoSelector (GoVar "gopurs_runtime") "Func")
        [ GoFuncLit [ Tuple param TypeValue ] [] inner TypeValue ])
      boxed wrapperParams

-- @inline Main.observeMap never
-- @inline Main.observeFold never

module Main where

-- @dependencies: prelude effect console refs arrays foldable-traversable maybe either exceptions

import Prelude
import Consumer as Consumer
import Data.Array as Array
import Data.Either (Either(..))
import Data.Foldable (for_)
import Data.FoldableWithIndex (foldlWithIndex)
import Data.Maybe (Maybe(..))
import Data.Traversable (traverse)
import Effect (Effect)
import Effect.Console (logShow)
import Effect.Exception (message, throw, try)
import Effect.Ref as Ref
import Effect.Unsafe (unsafePerformEffect)

mapScore :: Array Int -> Int
mapScore values = Consumer.consume (map (\value -> value + 1) values)

appendScore :: Array Int -> Array Int -> Int
appendScore left right = Consumer.consume (left <> right)

traverseSuccess :: Array Int -> Int
traverseSuccess values = case traverse (\value -> Just (value + 1)) values of
  Nothing -> -1
  Just mapped -> Consumer.consume mapped

traverseRejected :: Int -> Array Int -> Int
traverseRejected rejected values = case traverse (\value -> if value == rejected then Nothing else Just (value + 1)) values of
  Nothing -> -1
  Just mapped -> Consumer.consume mapped

mapCaptured :: Int -> Int -> Array Int -> Int
mapCaptured delta seed values = foldlWithIndex
  (\index total value -> total + (1 + index `mod` 2) * value) seed (map (\value -> value + delta) values)

appendSeeded :: Int -> Array Int -> Array Int -> Int
appendSeeded seed left right = foldlWithIndex
  (\index total value -> total + (1 + index `mod` 2) * value) seed (left <> right)

applyConsumer :: (Array Int -> Int) -> Array Int -> Int
applyConsumer callback values = callback values

encode :: Maybe (Array Int) -> Array Int
encode Nothing = [ 0 ]
encode (Just values) = Array.cons 1 values

type Trace = Ref.Ref (Array (Array Int))

observeMap :: Trace -> Int -> Int
observeMap trace value = unsafePerformEffect do
  Ref.modify_ (\events -> Array.snoc events [ 1, value ]) trace
  pure (value + 1)

observeFold :: Trace -> Int -> Int -> Int -> Int
observeFold trace index total value = unsafePerformEffect do
  Ref.modify_ (\events -> Array.snoc events [ 2, index, total, value ]) trace
  pure (total + (1 + index `mod` 2) * value)

mapFactory :: Trace -> (Int -> Int)
mapFactory trace = unsafePerformEffect do
  Ref.modify_ (\events -> Array.snoc events [ 10 ]) trace
  pure (observeMap trace)

foldFactory :: Trace -> (Int -> Int -> Int -> Int)
foldFactory trace = unsafePerformEffect do
  Ref.modify_ (\events -> Array.snoc events [ 11 ]) trace
  pure (observeFold trace)

seedFactory :: Trace -> Int -> Int
seedFactory trace seed = unsafePerformEffect do
  Ref.modify_ (\events -> Array.snoc events [ 12, seed ]) trace
  pure seed

inputFactory :: Trace -> Int -> Array Int -> Array Int
inputFactory trace tag values = unsafePerformEffect do
  Ref.modify_ (\events -> Array.snoc events [ tag, Array.length values ]) trace
  pure values

failingMap :: Trace -> Int -> Int
failingMap trace value = unsafePerformEffect do
  Ref.modify_ (\events -> Array.snoc events [ 3, value ]) trace
  if value == 3 then throw "producer failure" else pure (value + 1)

failingFold :: Trace -> Int -> Int -> Int -> Int
failingFold trace index _ _ = unsafePerformEffect do
  Ref.modify_ (\events -> Array.snoc events [ 4, index ]) trace
  throw "consumer failure"

failingTraverse :: Trace -> Int -> Maybe Int
failingTraverse trace value = unsafePerformEffect do
  Ref.modify_ (\events -> Array.snoc events [ 5, value ]) trace
  if value == 3 then throw "later traversal failure"
    else pure (if value == 1 then Nothing else Just (value + 1))

failingRight :: Trace -> Array Int -> Array Int
failingRight trace _ = unsafePerformEffect do
  Ref.modify_ (\events -> Array.snoc events [ 15 ]) trace
  throw "right input failure"

main :: Effect Unit
main = do
  inputs <- Ref.new
    [ { left: [], right: [], rejected: 99, delta: 7, seed: 19 }
    , { left: [ 1 ], right: [], rejected: 1, delta: 1, seed: -7 }
    , { left: [ 1, 2, 3, 4 ], right: [ 5, 6 ], rejected: 1, delta: -3, seed: 0 }
    , { left: [ 1, 2, 3, 4 ], right: [ 5 ], rejected: 3, delta: 7, seed: 5 }
    , { left: [ 1, 2, 3, 4 ], right: [ -2, -3 ], rejected: 4, delta: -1, seed: 2147483647 }
    , { left: [ -3, 0, -3, 5 ], right: [ 0 ], rejected: 99, delta: -2147483648, seed: -19 }
    , { left: [ 2147483647, -2147483648, -1, 0 ], right: [ 1, 2147483647 ], rejected: 19, delta: 1, seed: 2147483647 }
    , { left: [ -2147483648, 2147483647 ], right: [], rejected: -2147483648, delta: -1, seed: -2147483648 }
    , { left: [], right: [ 3, -1, 4 ], rejected: 3, delta: 1, seed: 7 }
    , { left: [ 4, -8, 9 ], right: [], rejected: 9, delta: 2147483647, seed: -7 }
    ]
  cases <- Ref.read inputs
  for_ cases \c -> do
    let
      mapped = map (_ + 1) c.left
      appended = c.left <> c.right
      traversed = traverse (\value -> if value == c.rejected then Nothing else Just (value + 1)) c.left
    stored <- Ref.new traversed
    replayed <- Ref.read stored
    logShow [ mapScore c.left, appendScore c.left c.right, traverseSuccess c.left
      , traverseRejected c.rejected c.left, mapCaptured c.delta c.seed c.left
      , appendSeeded c.seed c.left c.right, mapScore c.left ]
    logShow [ c.left, c.right, mapped, appended, encode traversed, encode replayed, mapped, c.left, c.right ]
  consumerRef <- Ref.new Consumer.consume
  callback <- Ref.read consumerRef
  logShow [ callback [ 1, 2, 3 ], callback [], callback [ 4, -1 ] ]
  logShow (applyConsumer callback [ 2, 0, -3 ])
  input <- Ref.new [ 1, 2, 3, 4 ]
  values <- Ref.read input
  trace <- Ref.new []
  -- Sequence these observable factories through Effect. The separate archived
  -- unsequenced diagnostic records a pre-existing generic argument-order issue.
  foldRef <- Ref.new (foldFactory trace)
  fold <- Ref.read foldRef
  seedRef <- Ref.new (seedFactory trace 7)
  seed <- Ref.read seedRef
  logShow (foldlWithIndex fold seed
    (map (mapFactory trace) (inputFactory trace 13 values)))
  Ref.read trace >>= logShow
  partialTrace <- Ref.new []
  partialRef <- Ref.new (foldlWithIndex (foldFactory partialTrace) (seedFactory partialTrace 7))
  partial <- Ref.read partialRef
  logShow [ partial [ 1, 2 ], partial [], partial [ 3 ] ]
  Ref.read partialTrace >>= logShow
  mapTrace <- Ref.new []
  mapOutcome <- try do
    current <- Ref.read input
    pure (foldlWithIndex (failingFold mapTrace) 0 (map (failingMap mapTrace) current))
  logShow (case mapOutcome of
    Left error -> message error
    Right value -> show value)
  Ref.read mapTrace >>= logShow
  traverseTrace <- Ref.new []
  traverseOutcome <- try do
    current <- Ref.read input
    pure (case traverse (failingTraverse traverseTrace) current of
      Nothing -> -1
      Just result -> Consumer.consume result)
  logShow (case traverseOutcome of
    Left error -> message error
    Right value -> show value)
  Ref.read traverseTrace >>= logShow
  appendTrace <- Ref.new []
  appendOutcome <- try do
    current <- Ref.read input
    pure (foldlWithIndex (failingFold appendTrace) 0
      (inputFactory appendTrace 14 current <> failingRight appendTrace current))
  logShow (case appendOutcome of
    Left error -> message error
    Right value -> show value)
  Ref.read appendTrace >>= logShow

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Archive the completed array intermediates campaign and its independently checked evidence."""
import argparse, difflib, hashlib, json, math, re, runpy, statistics, subprocess, sys
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path
sys.dont_write_bytecode = True
WORK = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
ROOT = WORK.parents[2]
COMPILER = ROOT.parent / 'gopurs/gopurs'
OUTPUT = ROOT / 'docs/benchmark-results/2026-11-26-go-array-intermediates.json'
REPORT = ROOT / 'docs/benchmark-results/2026-11-26-go-array-intermediates.md'
SCRIPTS = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
sha = lambda data: hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()


def artifact(path, omit=False):
    path = Path(path)
    data = path.read_bytes()
    result = {'sha256': sha(data), 'size_bytes': len(data)}
    if omit:
        result.update(text_omitted='Large generated overlay; reconstruct using the archived proof script, patch and original source hash.',
                      retained_path=str(path))
    else:
        result['text'] = data.decode('utf-8')
    return result


def verify(path, expected):
    if sha(Path(path).read_bytes()) != expected:
        raise ValueError('Hash mismatch: ' + str(path))


def git(*args):
    return subprocess.check_output(['git', '-C', str(COMPILER), *args], text=True)


def check_campaign(campaign):
    pair = runpy.run_path(str(SCRIPTS / 'measure-pair.py'))
    pair['verify_freeze'](campaign['frozen_reference'])
    pair['C']['verify_hashes'](campaign['compiler_snapshot']['files_sha256'])
    for entry in campaign['core_manifest']['plan']:
        verify(entry['manifest'], entry['manifest_sha256'])
        pair['C']['verify_hashes'](entry['payload_sha256'])
    all_cases = campaign['all_campaign']
    for variant, directory in all_cases['workspaces'].items():
        verify(Path(directory) / 'manifest.json', all_cases['manifest_sha256'][variant])
        verify(Path(directory) / 'benchmark', all_cases['executable_sha256'][variant])
    verify(WORK / 'campaign/core/results.json', campaign['core_manifest']['results_sha256'])
    verify(SCRIPTS / 'measure-pair.py', campaign['wrapper_sha256'])
    for variant, times in campaign['matched37_times_us'].items():
        assert len(times) == 37
        combined = dict(campaign['primary_times_us'][variant])
        combined.update({name: row['medians_us'][variant] for name, row in all_cases['all_tests'].items()
                         if name not in combined})
        assert times == combined
        expected = pair['metrics'](times, campaign['frozen_reference']['c37_times_us'])
        for metric, value in expected.items():
            assert math.isclose(value, campaign['aggregates'][variant][metric], rel_tol=1e-12)
    assert campaign['validation']['total_oracles'] == 306
    return {'cases': 37, 'oracles': 306, 'protected_current_files': len(campaign['frozen_reference']['source_sha256']),
            'protected_library_sources': len(campaign['frozen_reference']['library_sources_sha256']),
            'compiler_files': len(campaign['compiler_snapshot']['files_sha256']), 'all_guards_passed': True}


def check_inputs(campaign):
    result = {}
    expected_inputs, expected_stdout = None, None
    counts = None
    for variant in ('before', 'after'):
        directory = WORK / 'proofs' / ('runtime-inputs-' + variant)
        manifest = json.loads((directory / 'manifest.json').read_text())
        assert manifest['validated'] is True
        assert isinstance(manifest['input_variants'], int) and manifest['input_variants'] > 0
        assert isinstance(manifest['oracles'], int) and manifest['oracles'] > 0
        assert manifest['paths'] == ['Apply', 'ffi_conversion', 'forced_fallback']
        assert manifest['oracles'] == len(manifest['paths']) * manifest['input_variants']
        expected_calls = json.loads((SCRIPTS / 'runtime-proof-schema.json').read_text())
        assert manifest['preparation_opaque_calls_per_case'] == expected_calls['preparation_opaque_calls_per_case']
        action_calls = manifest['action_opaque_calls_per_case']
        assert isinstance(action_calls, dict) and action_calls
        assert action_calls == expected_calls['action_opaque_calls_per_case']
        assert manifest['action_replayed_with_changing_inputs'] is True
        assert manifest['inputs_immutable'] is True
        assert manifest['binary_sha256'] == campaign['all_campaign']['executable_sha256'][variant]
        verify(Path(manifest['build']) / 'benchmark', manifest['binary_sha256'])
        for name, digest in manifest['generated_source_sha256'].items():
            verify(name, digest)
        verify(directory / 'opaque-override.go', manifest['override_sha256'])
        stdout = (directory / 'stdout.txt').read_text()
        assert stdout == (directory / 'expected.txt').read_text() and not (directory / 'stderr.txt').read_text()
        assert len(stdout.splitlines()) == manifest['oracles']
        inputs = json.loads((directory / 'inputs.json').read_text())
        assert len(inputs) == manifest['input_variants']
        if expected_inputs is not None:
            assert inputs == expected_inputs and stdout == expected_stdout
            assert counts == (manifest['input_variants'], manifest['oracles'])
        expected_inputs, expected_stdout = inputs, stdout
        counts = (manifest['input_variants'], manifest['oracles'])
        result[variant] = manifest
    return {'variants_per_build': counts[0], 'oracles_per_build': counts[1], 'total_oracles': 2 * counts[1],
            'same_inputs_and_outputs': True, 'manifests': result}


def compiler_changes(baseline):
    names = set(git('ls-files', '--cached', '--others', '--exclude-standard').splitlines()) | set(baseline['sources'])
    tracked_before = set(git('ls-tree', '-r', '--name-only', baseline['head']).splitlines())
    before, after, patch = {}, {}, ''
    for name in sorted(names):
        if not (name.startswith(('src/', 'runtime/', 'tools/', 'tests/', 'docs/')) or name in
                ['CHANGELOG.md', 'README.md', 'package.json', 'package-lock.json', 'spago.yaml', 'spago.lock', 'bootstrap-sources.json']):
            continue
        if Path(name).suffix not in {'.purs', '.go', '.js', '.rs', '.mjs', '.md', '.json', '.yaml', '.lock'}:
            continue
        entry = baseline['sources'].get(name)
        old_from_git = False
        if entry:
            old = Path(entry['path']).read_text()
        elif 'source_inventory' in baseline:
            # A complete file snapshot records the actual working tree, including
            # dirty and untracked sources. Never substitute HEAD for that state.
            if name in baseline['source_inventory'] and name not in baseline.get('missing_source_files', []):
                raise ValueError('Missing file from complete baseline snapshot: ' + name)
            old = ''
        elif name in tracked_before:
            # The snapshot intentionally selected only some paths. A tracked
            # file absent from it is not necessarily a newly created file.
            if baseline['status'] != '':
                raise ValueError('Cannot recover an unsnapshotted file from a dirty baseline: ' + name)
            old = git('show', baseline['head'] + ':' + name)
            old_from_git = True
        else:
            old = ''
        current = COMPILER / name
        new = current.read_text() if current.is_file() else ''
        if old == new:
            continue
        if entry:
            before[name] = artifact(entry['path'])
        elif old_from_git:
            before[name] = {'sha256': sha(old.encode()), 'size_bytes': len(old.encode()), 'text': old,
                            'baseline_git_object': baseline['head'] + ':' + name}
        after[name] = artifact(current) if current.is_file() else {'deleted': True}
        patch += ''.join(difflib.unified_diff(old.splitlines(True), new.splitlines(True), fromfile='a/' + name, tofile='b/' + name))
    if not after:
        raise ValueError('Expected compiler changes relative to the frozen baseline')
    return before, after, {'sha256': sha(patch.encode()), 'text': patch}


def check_diagnostics(campaign):
    directory = WORK / 'proofs/isolated-regressions'
    result_path = directory / 'results.json'
    if not result_path.exists():
        return {'performed': False, 'primary_campaign_unchanged': True}
    diagnostics = json.loads(result_path.read_text())
    assert diagnostics['primary_campaign_sha256'] == sha((WORK / 'campaign/results.json').read_bytes())
    assert diagnostics['cases']
    assert diagnostics['oracles_verified'] == 6 * len(diagnostics['cases'])
    comparison = json.loads((directory / 'generated-comparison.json').read_text())
    for key, row in diagnostics['cases'].items():
        assert row['order'] == ['before', 'after', 'after', 'before', 'before', 'after']
        assert row['source_suite'] == ('core' if row['case'] in campaign['primary_times_us']['before'] else 'all')
        for side in ('before', 'after'):
            assert len(row['samples_us'][side]) == 3
            assert statistics.median(row['samples_us'][side]) == row['medians_us'][side]
            verify(directory / (key + '-' + side + '-main.go'), row['main_sha256'][side])
            verify(directory / (key + '-' + side + '-probe'), row['probe_binary_sha256'][side])
        change = 100 * (row['medians_us']['after'] / row['medians_us']['before'] - 1)
        assert math.isclose(change, row['change_percent'], rel_tol=1e-12)
        assert row['increase_over_5_percent_reproduced'] == (change > 5)
        assert all(section['byte_identical'] and section['normalized_identical']
                   for section in comparison[key]['sections'].values())
    return {'performed': True, 'isolated_oracles': diagnostics['oracles_verified'],
            'increases_over_5_percent_reproduced':
            [row['case'] for row in diagnostics['cases'].values() if row['increase_over_5_percent_reproduced']],
            'primary_campaign_unchanged': True}


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('--write', action='store_true')
    args = parser.parse_args()
    report_source = REPORT if REPORT.exists() else WORK / 'report.proposed.md'
    if args.write and report_source != REPORT:
        raise ValueError('Write the approved report before the final archive')
    campaign = json.loads((WORK / 'campaign/results.json').read_text())
    baseline = json.loads((WORK / 'compiler-before/manifest.json').read_text())
    checks = check_campaign(campaign)
    inputs = check_inputs(campaign)
    diagnostics = check_diagnostics(campaign)
    final = json.loads((WORK / 'validation-summary.json').read_text())
    if final.get('status') != 'passed':
        raise ValueError('Root-approved validation summary must be passed')
    for check in final.get('required_node_logs', []):
        text = (WORK / check['path']).read_text()
        assert re.search(r'^ℹ pass ' + str(check['passed']) + '$', text, re.M)
        assert re.search(r'^ℹ fail 0$', text, re.M)
    before, after, patch = compiler_changes(baseline)
    proofs = {}
    for path in sorted((WORK / 'proofs').rglob('*')):
        if path.is_file() and path.suffix in {'.json', '.go', '.py', '.mjs', '.js', '.purs', '.md', '.stdout', '.stderr', '.txt', '.patch', '.log'}:
            proofs[str(path.relative_to(WORK / 'proofs'))] = artifact(path)
    logs = {str(path.relative_to(WORK)): artifact(path) for pattern in
            ['*.log', 'validation-logs/*.log', 'logs/*.log', 'after-core/logs/*.log', 'after-all/logs/*.log']
            for path in sorted(WORK.glob(pattern))}
    campaign_files = {str(path.relative_to(WORK)): artifact(path) for path in sorted((WORK / 'campaign').rglob('*'))
                      if path.is_file() and path.name != 'results.json'}
    supporting_paths = [WORK / name for name in ['implementation.md', 'regression-review.md',
        'after-build-compiler.json', 'private-st-warning-provenance.json']]
    supporting_paths += [path for pattern in ['real-*.txt', 'real-*.go', 'real-*.json'] for path in sorted(WORK.glob(pattern)) if path.is_file()]
    supporting_paths += [path for folder in ['diagnostic-probe','probe'] for path in sorted((WORK / folder).rglob('*')) if path.is_file()]
    supporting_files = {str(path.relative_to(WORK)): artifact(path) for path in supporting_paths if path.is_file()}
    archive = {
        'date': '2026-11-26', 'archived_at_utc': datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(), 'campaign': campaign,
        'report': {'path': str(REPORT.relative_to(ROOT)), **artifact(report_source)},
        'compiler': {'baseline_head': baseline['head'], 'baseline_kind': baseline.get('baseline_kind', 'dirty measured snapshot' if baseline['status'] else 'clean measured snapshot'),
                     'head_at_archive': git('rev-parse', 'HEAD').strip(), 'status_at_archive': git('status', '--porcelain'),
                     'baseline_manifest': baseline, 'measured_snapshot': campaign['compiler_snapshot'],
                     'diff_from_baseline': patch, 'before_sources': before, 'changed_sources': after},
        'validation': {'final_summary': final, 'summary_source': artifact(WORK / 'validation-summary.json'),
                       'campaign': campaign['validation'], 'runtime_input_proofs': inputs,
                       'archive_checks': checks, 'diagnostic_checks': diagnostics, 'logs': logs},
        'proofs': {'runtime_inputs_and_collectors': proofs, 'campaign_files': campaign_files,
                   'supporting_files': supporting_files,
                   'original_collectors': {name: artifact(ROOT / name) for name in
                       ['bin/benchmark/measure.py', 'bin/benchmark/js-ratios.py', 'bin/benchmark/compare-core.py',
                        'bin/benchmark/publish.py', 'bin/benchmark/validate.py']},
                   'reference_note': 'All 37 C medians are frozen. C/JS sources and historical times are unchanged; neither reference was remeasured.'},
        'preservation_note': 'Raw measurements, manifests, source snapshots, compiler changes and validation evidence are retained in the workspace and archived here. The deleted repository ratio catalogue is not recreated.'}
    serialized = json.dumps(archive, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, allow_nan=False) + '\n'
    if args.write:
        if OUTPUT.exists():
            raise ValueError('Refusing to overwrite an archive')
        OUTPUT.write_text(serialized)
    print(json.dumps({'written': args.write, 'path': str(OUTPUT), 'bytes': len(serialized.encode()),
                      'sha256': sha(serialized.encode()), 'compiler_changed_files': list(after),
                      'checks': checks, 'runtime_oracles': inputs['total_oracles']}, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

"""Static generated-source inventory; counts are source occurrences, not measured allocations."""
import hashlib,re
TARGETS=['ArrayMap10000','ArrayAppend1000','TraverseMaybe1000',
         'TraverseMaybeFailFirst1000','TraverseMaybeFailLast1000',
         'ArrayFilter10000','ArraySortDescending10000']
def describe(data):
    text=data.decode() if isinstance(data,bytes) else data
    return {'sha256':hashlib.sha256(text.encode()).hexdigest(),
        'opaque_preserved':'Get_Bench_opaque()' in text,
        'native_checksum_call_occurrences':text.count('Call_Bench_ArrayFixtures_weightedChecksum('),
        'boxed_checksum_getter_occurrences':text.count('Get_Bench_ArrayFixtures_weightedChecksum()'),
        'native_array_make_occurrences':text.count('make([]int64'),
        'boxed_array_make_occurrences':len(re.findall(r'make\(\[\]\w+\.Value',text)),
        'boxed_array_bridge_occurrences':len(re.findall(r'boxed := make\(\[\]\w+\.Value',text)),
        'unboxed_array_bridge_occurrences':text.count('unboxed := make([]int64'),
        'traverse_native_output':bool(re.search(r'traverse\w*_output[^\n]*\[\]int64',text)),
        'source_counts_are_not_runtime_allocations':True}

def function_body(source,name):
    text=source.decode() if isinstance(source,bytes) else source
    start=text.index('func '+name+'(')
    opening=text.index('{',start)
    depth=0
    pattern=r'"(?:\\.|[^"\\])*"|`[^`]*`|\'(?:\\.|[^\'\\])*\'|//[^\n]*|/\*[\s\S]*?\*/|[{}]'
    for token in re.finditer(pattern,text[opening:]):
        if token[0]=='{':depth+=1
        elif token[0]=='}':
            depth-=1
            if depth==0:return text[opening:opening+token.end()]
    raise ValueError('Unterminated generated function '+name)

def assert_target_shape(name,source):
    text=source.decode() if isinstance(source,bytes) else source
    body=function_body(text,'Get_Test_'+name+'_prepare')
    assert 'Call_Bench_ArrayFixtures_weightedChecksum(' in body,name
    assert 'Get_Bench_ArrayFixtures_weightedChecksum()' not in body,name
    if name in ['ArrayMap10000','ArrayAppend1000','TraverseMaybe1000','TraverseMaybeFailFirst1000','TraverseMaybeFailLast1000','ArrayFilter10000']:
        assert not re.search(r'\bboxed := make|\bunboxed := make',body),name
    if name=='ArrayAppend1000':
        assert re.search(r'concatInt_output_\w* := make\(\[\]int64',body)
        arg_assignments=[m.start() for m in re.finditer(r'concatInt_arg_\w* :=',body)]
        sources=[m.start() for m in re.finditer(r'concatInt_source_\w* :=',body)]
        assert len(arg_assignments)==len(sources)==2 and max(arg_assignments)<min(sources)
    if name.startswith('TraverseMaybe'):
        assert re.search(r'traverseTotal_output_\w* := \[\]int64',body)
        assert 'Constructor_Data_Maybe_Just[[]int64]' in body
    return {'native_consumer':True,'boxed_bridge_in_prepare':bool(re.search(r'\bboxed := make',body)),
            'unboxed_bridge_in_prepare':bool(re.search(r'\bunboxed := make',body)),
            'prepare_sha256':hashlib.sha256(body.encode()).hexdigest()}

def assert_shared_shape(source):
    text=source.decode() if isinstance(source,bytes) else source
    getter=function_body(text,'Get_Bench_ArrayFixtures_weightedChecksum')
    worker=function_body(text,'Call_Bench_ArrayFixtures_weightedChecksum')
    assert re.search(r'func Call_Bench_ArrayFixtures_weightedChecksum\([^\n]*\[\]int64\) int64',text)
    assert re.search(r'\*\[\]\w+\.Value',getter)
    assert 'make(' not in getter and 'GoUnboxIntArray' not in getter and 'unboxed :=' not in getter
    assert 'indexedFold_values_' in worker and 'range indexedFold_values_' in worker
    return {'worker_native_int_array':True,'public_getter_preserves_boxed_loop_without_copy':True,
            'getter_sha256':hashlib.sha256(getter.encode()).hexdigest(),'worker_sha256':hashlib.sha256(worker.encode()).hexdigest()}

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Separate AB/BA/AB diagnostics for primary increases, preserving primary samples."""
from pathlib import Path
import argparse, difflib, hashlib, json, math, os, re, runpy, statistics, subprocess, sys
from datetime import datetime, timezone
sys.dont_write_bytecode = True
ROOT = Path('/Users/0x1/Documents/htdocs/altbak.pub')
WORK = ROOT / 'var/benchmark/go-array-intermediates-20261126'
PROOF = WORK / 'proofs/isolated-regressions'
HELPERS = runpy.run_path(str(Path(__file__).with_name('compare-generated.py')))
sha = lambda path: hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
primary = WORK / 'campaign/results.json'
primary_sha = sha(primary)
report = json.loads(primary.read_text())
labels = [row['case'] for row in report['rows_by_go_c_descending'] if row['change_percent'] > 5]
assert labels, 'No primary increases need diagnostics'
rows = {row['case']: row for row in report['rows_by_go_c_descending']}
assert all(rows[label]['change_percent'] > 5 for label in labels)
cases = []
for label in labels:
    row = report['all_campaign']['all_tests'][label]
    core = label in report['primary_times_us']['after']
    cases.append({'key': re.sub(r'[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]+', '-', label), 'label': label,
                  'module': row['module'].replace('.', '_'),
                  'getter': 'Get_' + row['module'].replace('.', '_') + ('_act' if core else '_prepare'),
                  'expected': row['expected'], 'prepare': not core, 'source_suite': 'core' if core else 'all',
                  'primary_change_percent': rows[label]['change_percent']})
parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
parser.add_argument('--execute', action='store_true')
args = parser.parse_args()
if not args.execute:
    print(json.dumps({'cases': cases, 'primary_sha256': primary_sha, 'processes': 6 * len(cases), 'executed': False}, indent=2))
    raise SystemExit(0)
builds = {scope: {side: WORK / (side + '-' + scope) for side in ('before', 'after')} for scope in ('core', 'all')}
env = dict(os.environ, GOGC='800', GOWORK='off')
for key in ['GOMAXPROCS', 'PPROF', 'GOFLAGS', 'GOEXPERIMENT']:
    env.pop(key, None)
PROOF.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
(PROOF / 'inputs.json').write_text(json.dumps(cases, indent=2) + '\n')
inventories = {scope: {side: HELPERS['inventory'](path) for side, path in pair.items()} for scope, pair in builds.items()}
originals = {scope: {side: inventory['provenance'] for side, inventory in pair.items()} for scope, pair in inventories.items()}
commands, sources, comparisons = {}, {}, {}


def normalize(body):
    # Canonicalize only generated package aliases/runtime spelling and trailing
    # whitespace; preserve calls, literals, arithmetic, local names and order.
    body = re.sub(r'\b(?:g[0-9a-f]{6})\.', 'package.', body.decode())
    body = re.sub(r'\br_\.', 'r.', body)
    return '\n'.join(line.rstrip() for line in body.splitlines()).strip() + '\n'


# First compare target module and original harness sections, before building probes.
for case in cases:
    key = case['key']
    selected = {'Bench.go', 'Bench_ffi.go', 'Effect_Console.go', 'Effect_Console_ffi.go', case['module'] + '.go'}
    extracted = {side: {name: body for name, body in inventory['sections'].items() if Path(name).name in selected}
                 for side, inventory in inventories[case['source_suite']].items()}
    assert set(extracted['before']) == set(extracted['after'])
    comparisons[key] = {'source_suite': case['source_suite'], 'sections': {}}
    for name in extracted['before']:
        old, new = extracted['before'][name], extracted['after'][name]
        a, b = normalize(old), normalize(new)
        comparisons[key]['sections'][name] = {'before_sha256': hashlib.sha256(old).hexdigest(),
                                              'after_sha256': hashlib.sha256(new).hexdigest(),
                                              'byte_identical': old == new, 'normalized_identical': a == b,
                                              'before': old.decode(), 'after': new.decode(),
                                              'normalized_diff': ''.join(difflib.unified_diff(a.splitlines(True), b.splitlines(True)))}
    assert all(item['normalized_identical'] for item in comparisons[key]['sections'].values()), ('Changed target/harness code', key)
(PROOF / 'generated-comparison.json').write_text(json.dumps(comparisons, indent=2) + '\n')
print('All selected target modules and harness sections are unchanged after normalization.', flush=True)

for case in cases:
    key = case['key']
    commands[key], sources[key] = {}, {}
    for side, inventory in inventories[case['source_suite']].items():
        owner = lambda name: [str(Path(path).parent) for path, body in inventory['sections'].items()
                              if re.search(rb'func ' + name.encode() + rb'\(', body)]
        action, bench, console = owner(case['getter']), owner('Call_Bench_runBench'), owner('Get_Effect_Console_log')
        assert len(action) == len(bench) == len(console) == 1
        packages = sorted(set(action + bench + console))
        aliases = {name: 'p' + str(i) for i, name in enumerate(packages)}
        imports = '; '.join(aliases[name] + ' "gopurs/output/' + name + '"' for name in packages)
        act = aliases[action[0]] + '.' + case['getter'] + '()'
        if case['prepare']:
            act = 'r.Apply(' + act + ',r.Value{})'
        main = f'''package main
import(r "gopurs/output/gopurs_runtime"; {imports})
func main(){{
 act:={act}
 for i:=0;i<3;i++{{if value:=r.Apply(act,r.Value{{}});value.Type!=r.TypeInt||value.IntVal!={case['expected']}{{panic("invalid global warmup result")}}}}
 describe:=r.Apply({aliases[console[0]]}.Get_Effect_Console_log(),r.Str("{case['label']}"))
 r.Apply({aliases[bench[0]]}.Call_Bench_runBench(describe,act),r.Value{{}})
}}
'''
        source = PROOF / (key + '-' + side + '-main.go')
        source.write_text(main)
        sources[key][side] = sha(source)
        command = ['go', 'build', '-pgo=off', '-o', str(PROOF / (key + '-' + side + '-probe')), str(source)]
        process = subprocess.run(command, cwd=builds[case['source_suite']][side] / 'output', env=env, text=True, capture_output=True)
        (PROOF / (key + '-' + side + '-build.stdout')).write_text(process.stdout)
        (PROOF / (key + '-' + side + '-build.stderr')).write_text(process.stderr)
        process.check_returncode()
        assert not process.stderr
        commands[key][side] = command
        print('Built', key, side, flush=True)

# All probe builds complete before the first timed process.
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / 'bin/benchmark'))
from validate import ROW
order = ['before', 'after', 'after', 'before', 'before', 'after']
results = {}
for case in cases:
    key = case['key']
    samples, runs = {'before': [], 'after': []}, []
    for index, side in enumerate(order, 1):
        process = subprocess.run([str(PROOF / (key + '-' + side + '-probe'))],
                                 cwd=builds[case['source_suite']][side] / 'output', env=env,
                                 text=True, capture_output=True, timeout=60)
        stem = f'{key}-{index}-{side}'
        (PROOF / (stem + '.stdout')).write_text(process.stdout)
        (PROOF / (stem + '.stderr')).write_text(process.stderr)
        process.check_returncode()
        assert not process.stderr
        values = ROW.findall(process.stdout)
        assert len(values) == 1 and process.stdout.count('(Test)') == 1
        label, value, elapsed = values[0]
        assert label.strip() == case['label'] and value.strip() == str(case['expected'])
        elapsed = float(elapsed)
        assert math.isfinite(elapsed) and elapsed > 0
        batches = [int(n) for n in re.findall(r'^Batch iterations: (\d+)$', process.stdout, re.M)]
        assert len(batches) == 1 and 0 < batches[0] <= 16777216 and not batches[0] & (batches[0] - 1)
        samples[side].append(elapsed)
        runs.append({'variant': side, 'time_us': elapsed, 'batch_iterations': batches[0],
                     'stdout': process.stdout, 'stderr': process.stderr})
        print(stem, elapsed, 'us', flush=True)
    medians = {side: statistics.median(values) for side, values in samples.items()}
    change = 100 * (medians['after'] / medians['before'] - 1)
    results[key] = {'case': case['label'], 'source_suite': case['source_suite'], 'expected': case['expected'],
                    'original_builds': originals[case['source_suite']], 'commands': commands[key],
                    'main_sha256': sources[key], 'probe_binary_sha256': {side: sha(PROOF / (key + '-' + side + '-probe')) for side in samples},
                    'order': order, 'samples_us': samples, 'medians_us': medians, 'change_percent': change,
                    'primary_change_percent': case['primary_change_percent'], 'increase_over_5_percent_reproduced': change > 5,
                    'runs': runs}
for scope, pair in builds.items():
    for side, path in pair.items():
        assert originals[scope][side] == HELPERS['inventory'](path)['provenance']
assert sha(primary) == primary_sha
result = {'measured_at_utc': datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
          'scope': 'Separate diagnostics only; original primary samples and aggregates remain unchanged',
          'protocol': 'AB/BA/AB for each case; actual getters and unchanged Bench.runBench; 3 global warmups then calibration and minimum of ten batches; all builds finished before timing',
          'GOGC': '800', 'GOMAXPROCS': 'default', 'host_isolated': False,
          'source_comparison': 'generated-comparison.json', 'script_sha256': sha(__file__),
          'primary_campaign_sha256': primary_sha, 'cases': results, 'oracles_verified': 6 * len(cases),
          'original_generated_sources_and_binaries_unchanged': True}
(PROOF / 'results.json').write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2) + '\n')
print(json.dumps({key: {name: row[name] for name in ['case', 'source_suite', 'samples_us', 'medians_us', 'change_percent', 'increase_over_5_percent_reproduced']}
                  for key, row in results.items()}, indent=2))

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Pair frozen Go App/AppAll builds against all 37 unchanged archived C medians."""
import argparse
from datetime import datetime, timezone
import hashlib
import json
import math
import os
from pathlib import Path
import platform
import runpy
import statistics
import subprocess
import sys

sys.dont_write_bytecode = True
ROOT = Path('/Users/0x1/Documents/htdocs/altbak.pub')
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / 'bin/benchmark'))
C = runpy.run_path(str(ROOT / 'bin/benchmark/compare-core.py'))
J = runpy.run_path(str(ROOT / 'bin/benchmark/js-ratios.py'))


def sha(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def write(path, value):
    Path(path).write_text(json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, allow_nan=False) + '\n')


def metrics(times, reference):
    if set(times) != set(reference) or len(times) not in (14, 37):
        raise ValueError('Identical Go/C case populations of 14 or 37 required')
    ratios = [times[name] / reference[name] for name in times]
    if any(not math.isfinite(x) or x <= 0 for x in ratios):
        raise ValueError('Invalid ratio')
    return {'total': sum(times.values()) / sum(reference.values()),
            'arithmetic': statistics.mean(ratios), 'median': statistics.median(ratios),
            'geometric': math.exp(statistics.mean(math.log(x) for x in ratios))}


def verify_freeze(frozen):
    baseline_path = Path(frozen['compiler_baseline_manifest'])
    if sha(baseline_path) != frozen['compiler_baseline_manifest_sha256']:
        raise ValueError('Compiler baseline manifest changed')
    baseline = json.loads(baseline_path.read_text())
    for group in ['files', 'sources']:
        C['verify_hashes']({entry['path']: entry['sha256'] for entry in baseline[group].values()})
    C['verify_hashes'](frozen['source_sha256'], ROOT)
    C['verify_hashes'](frozen['library_sources_sha256'])
    C['verify_hashes'](frozen['reference_files_sha256'])
    for build in [frozen['go_before_core'], frozen['c_build']]:
        C['verify_hashes']({build['manifest_path']: build['manifest_sha256']})
        C['verify_hashes'](build['payload_sha256'])
    old_all = frozen['go_before_all']
    path = Path(old_all['directory'])
    C['verify_hashes']({str(path / 'manifest.json'): old_all['manifest_sha256'],
                       str(path / 'benchmark'): old_all['manifest']['binary_sha256']})


def compiler_snapshot():
    root = ROOT.parent / 'gopurs/gopurs'
    paths = [root / 'bin/gopurs-native', root / 'bin/gopurs.js', root / 'bin/gopurs']
    paths += [path for folder in ['src', 'runtime'] for path in sorted((root / folder).rglob('*'))
              if path.is_file() and path.suffix in {'.purs', '.go', '.js', '.rs'}]
    return {'root': str(root),
            'head': subprocess.check_output(['git', '-C', str(root), 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'], text=True).strip(),
            'files_sha256': {str(path): sha(path) for path in paths}}


def plan_entry(key, build):
    return {'key': key, 'mode': 'pure', 'command': build['command'],
            'artifact': build['cwd'], 'cwd': build['cwd'],
            'manifest': build['manifest_path'], 'manifest_sha256': build['manifest_sha256'],
            'payload_sha256': build['payload_sha256'],
            'executable_sha256': build['manifest']['binary_sha256']}


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('--freeze', type=Path, default=Path(__file__).with_name('freeze.json'))
    parser.add_argument('--after-core', type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--after-all', type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--output', type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--execute', action='store_true', help='run only after all builds and tests have finished')
    args = parser.parse_args()
    frozen = json.loads(args.freeze.read_text())

    after_core = C['inspect_go'](args.after_core.resolve())

    after_all = J['inspect'](args.after_all.resolve())
    for label, before, after in [('core', before_core['manifest'], after_core['manifest']),
                                 ('all', before_all, after_all)]:
        for field in ['profile', 'toolchain']:
            if before[field] != after[field]:
                raise ValueError(f'{label} build {field} differs')
        for name in before['inputs']:
            if name.startswith(('src/', 'srx/')) and before['inputs'][name] != after['inputs'].get(name):
                raise ValueError(f'{label} benchmark input differs: {name}')

        raise ValueError('Distinct before/after builds are required')
    plan = [plan_entry('before', before_core), plan_entry('after', after_core)]
    if not args.execute:
        print(json.dumps({'validated': True, 'core_plan': plan,
                          'all_pair': [frozen['go_before_all']['directory'], str(args.after_all.resolve())],
                          'C_reference_remeasured': False, 'processes': 12}, indent=2))
        return
    args.output = args.output.resolve()
    args.output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
    write(args.output / 'freeze.json', frozen)
    write(args.output / 'core-plan.json', plan)

    for key in ['GOMAXPROCS', 'PPROF']:
        env.pop(key, None)
    compiler = compiler_snapshot()
    started = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
    load_start = list(os.getloadavg())
    commands = [
        [sys.executable, '-B', str(ROOT / 'bin/benchmark/measure.py'), '--plan',
         str(args.output / 'core-plan.json'), '--output', str(args.output / 'core')],
        [sys.executable, '-B', str(Path(__file__).with_name('collect-all.py')), '--before',
         frozen['go_before_all']['directory'], '--after', str(args.after_all.resolve()),
         '--output', str(args.output / 'all')],
    ]
    for command in commands:
        verify_freeze(frozen)
        C['verify_hashes'](compiler['files_sha256'])
        subprocess.run(command, cwd=ROOT, env=env, check=True)
        verify_freeze(frozen)
        C['verify_hashes'](compiler['files_sha256'])
    core = json.loads((args.output / 'core/results.json').read_text())
    all_cases = json.loads((args.output / 'all/results.json').read_text())
    labels = C['ROWS']
    core_times = {variant: dict(zip(labels, data['times_us'])) for variant, data in core.items()}
    core_aggregates = {variant: metrics(times, frozen['c_times_us']) for variant, times in core_times.items()}
    core_historical = metrics(frozen['historical_go_core_times_us'], frozen['c_times_us'])
    for key, value in core_historical.items():
        if not math.isclose(value, frozen['historical_aggregates'][key], rel_tol=1e-12):
            raise ValueError('Historical metrics do not reproduce the official archive')
    # Preserve the publication's primary App medians for core14, and use AppAll
    # for library23 only. Both sides of every aggregate now contain all 37 cases.
    matched37 = {
        variant: {name: core_times[variant][name] if name in core_times[variant]
                  else row['medians_us'][variant]
                  for name, row in all_cases['all_tests'].items()}
        for variant in ('before', 'after')}
    aggregates = {variant: metrics(times, frozen['c37_times_us']) for variant, times in matched37.items()}
    historical = metrics(frozen['historical_go37_times_us'], frozen['c37_times_us'])
    for key, prior_key in [('total', '/'), ('arithmetic', 'μ'), ('median', 'Q₂'), ('geometric', 'G')]:
        if not math.isclose(historical[key], frozen['historical37_aggregates'][prior_key], rel_tol=1e-12):
            raise ValueError('Historical 37-case metrics do not reproduce the official README')
    rows = []
    for name in matched37['after']:
        before, after = matched37['before'][name], matched37['after'][name]
        if name in labels:
            index = labels.index(name)
            samples = {variant: [sample['times_us'][index] for sample in core[variant]['process_runs']]
                       for variant in ['before', 'after']}
        else:
            samples = all_cases['all_tests'][name]['samples_us']
        rows.append({'case': name, 'times_us': {'before': before, 'after': after, 'c': frozen['c37_times_us'][name]},
                     'go_over_c': {variant: times[name] / frozen['c37_times_us'][name] for variant, times in matched37.items()},
                     'samples_us': samples, 'speedup': before / after, 'change_percent': 100 * (after / before - 1),
                     'before_over_historical': before / frozen['historical_go37_times_us'][name]})
    all_regressions = sorted([{'case': name, 'change_percent': case['change_percent'],
                              'medians_us': case['medians_us'], 'samples_us': case['samples_us']}
                             for name, case in all_cases['all_tests'].items() if case['change_percent'] > 5],
                            key=lambda row: -row['change_percent'])
    raw_core = {path.name: path.read_text() for suffix in ['stdout', 'stderr']
                for path in sorted((args.output / 'core').glob('*.' + suffix))}
    report = {'started_at_utc': started, 'completed_at_utc': datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
              'host': platform.platform(), 'machine': platform.machine(), 'host_isolated': False,
              'load_average_start': load_start, 'load_average_end': list(os.getloadavg()),
              'protocol': {'paired_order': 'AB/BA/AB', 'processes_per_build': 3,
                           'primary': '14 App core medians plus 23 AppAll library medians; all four Go/C aggregates use 37 matched cases',
                           'GOGC': '800', 'GOMAXPROCS': 'default', 'pgo': False,
                           'C_reference_remeasured': False, 'JS_reference_remeasured': False,
                           'aggregation': 'median of three process minima for each case'},
              'commands': commands, 'wrapper_sha256': sha(Path(__file__)),
              'frozen_reference': frozen, 'compiler_snapshot': compiler, 'aggregates': aggregates, 'historical_aggregates': historical,
              'primary_times_us': core_times, 'primary_total_ms': {k: sum(v.values())/1000 for k,v in core_times.items()},
              'matched37_times_us': matched37, 'matched37_total_ms': {k: sum(v.values())/1000 for k,v in matched37.items()},
              'core14_aggregates': core_aggregates, 'historical_core14_aggregates': core_historical,
              'c_total_ms': sum(frozen['c37_times_us'].values())/1000,
              'rows_by_go_c_descending': sorted(rows, key=lambda r: -r['go_over_c']['after']),
              'all_case_regressions_over_5_percent': all_regressions,
              'validation': {'processes': 12, 'core_oracles': 84, 'all_oracles': 222,
                             'total_oracles': 306, 'source_and_binary_guards': True},
              'core_manifest': json.loads((args.output / 'core/manifest.json').read_text()),
              'core_campaign': core, 'raw_core_outputs': raw_core, 'all_campaign': all_cases}
    write(args.output / 'results.json', report)
    print(json.dumps({'aggregates': aggregates, 'historical': historical,
                      'totals_ms': report['matched37_total_ms'], 'c_total_ms': report['c_total_ms'],
                      'all_regressions_over_5_percent': all_regressions}, indent=2))


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
